zuckerberg.en: Open-sourcing AI is safer than closed models; the real risk is amplifying known harms, not superintelligence.
zuckerberg.zh: 2023 年他主张开源 AI 比闭源更安全,最大风险是放大已知危害,而非超级智能。

zuckerberg.en: Scaling alone may not reach AGI; intelligence is separable from consciousness, and open source prevents power concentration.
zuckerberg.zh: 2024 年他深化判断:仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）未必通向 AGI（通用人工智能）,智能可与意识分离,开源能防止权力集中。

zuckerberg.en: AI should give everyone superintelligence and boost creativity; energy and infrastructure are the key scaling bottlenecks.
zuckerberg.zh: 2025 年他转向普惠叙事:AI 应赋予每个人超级智能并激发创造力,能源与基础设施成为 Scaling（规模扩张）的关键瓶颈。

zuckerberg.en: Distributed, open AI with personal agents like Muse is safer; frontier AI and biology integrate via world models and interpretability.
zuckerberg.zh: 2026 年他进一步主张分布式开源 AI 与 Muse 等个人智能体更安全,并推动前沿 AI 与生物学通过世界模型和可解释性融合。

animaanandkumar.en: Neural operators generalize networks to function spaces, letting AI weather models match physics-based forecasts while being tens of thousands of times faster.
animaanandkumar.zh: 神经算子把神经网络推广到函数空间,使 AI 天气模型在精度上比肩物理模型,速度却快数万倍。

animaanandkumar.en: Domain structure like spherical geometry is crucial for stable long-term climate modeling, letting one model handle both weather and climate.
animaanandkumar.zh: 球面几何等领域结构对稳定的长期气候建模至关重要,让单一模型同时处理天气与气候。

animaanandkumar.en: Physics-informed neural operators combine data-driven learning with physical constraints to overcome pure PINNs' limits.
animaanandkumar.zh: 物理信息神经算子把数据驱动学习与物理约束结合,以克服纯 PINN 的局限。

animaanandkumar.en: AI for science needs principled verification and robustness to ensure reliability in physical applications.
animaanandkumar.zh: AI for science 需要原则性的验证与鲁棒性,以确保物理应用中的可靠性。

animaanandkumar.en: Transformers are impractical for high-resolution physical simulation due to quadratic complexity; physical structure demands alternative architectures.
animaanandkumar.zh: 由于二次复杂度,Transformer 不适用于高分辨率物理模拟;物理结构要求替代架构。

joellewenstein.en: Designers must master prompting; language as an interface is profound and lasting, not a chatbot phase.
joellewenstein.zh: 设计师必须掌握提示词；语言作为界面深刻而持久，聊天机器人并非一时风潮。

joellewenstein.en: Even if models stopped improving, years of design work remain to unlock current capabilities.
joellewenstein.zh: 即便模型停止进步，仍需多年设计工作来释放当前能力。

joellewenstein.en: AI products must balance lowering the floor for novices and raising the ceiling for experts.
joellewenstein.zh: AI 产品需平衡降低新手门槛与提升专家上限。

joellewenstein.en: From designer-led strategy to letting the model lead: scaling laws mean the model creates most value.
joellewenstein.zh: 从设计师主导策略转向让模型主导：缩放定律意味着模型本身创造大部分价值。

joellewenstein.en: Ship light-touch products, use internal traction as signal, and treat production codebase as source of truth.
joellewenstein.zh: 发布轻量产品，以内部牵引为信号，将生产代码库视为产品与设计的真相来源。

altman.en: Early Altman: cut cognitive load, explore cheaply, and note AGI will reduce the premium on human intelligence.
altman.zh: 2018 年，Altman 强调减少认知负荷、低成本探索再果断砍掉无效项，并已预判 AGI 会降低人类智能的溢价。

altman.en: RLHF makes models usable with little data; alignment and capability are linked; deploy early so society adapts.
altman.zh: 2023 到 2024 年，他认为基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）用极少数据就让模型可用，对齐与能力紧密相连，应尽早部署让社会适应。

altman.en: Compute becomes the key bottleneck and commodity; iterative deployment and safety-through-use replace end-stage alignment.
altman.zh: 2024 到 2025 年，算力成为核心瓶颈与商品，迭代部署与在真实使用中做安全取代了事后对齐。

altman.en: AGI is a gradient, not a milestone; focus shifts to superintelligence, agentic safety, and personal AGI.
altman.zh: 2025 到 2026 年，AGI 被视为渐变而非里程碑，重心转向超级智能、智能体式安全与个人 AGI。

altman.en: Alignment and security must advance with capabilities; pause training if needed, keep humans in control, distribute power.
altman.zh: 2026 年，对齐与安全必须与能力同步推进，必要时暂停训练，确保人类掌控并广泛分配权力。

kokotajlo.en: Superintelligence likely arrives by 2029-2030; ~70% chance of catastrophic loss of control; interpretability is crucial.
kokotajlo.zh: 2026年，他判断超级智能可能在2029-2030年到来，失控等灾难性结局概率约70%，并强调可解释性是理解AI内部机制的关键。

kokotajlo.en: Policy should delay superintelligence; total research transparency and scenario scrutiny are essential to avoid power concentration.
kokotajlo.zh: 2026年，他把AI政策的首要目标定为推迟超级智能，以透明数据中心、公开训练日志等全面研究透明与情景推演来防止权力集中。

kokotajlo.en: By default AI firms automate AI research, causing recursive self-improvement and an intelligence explosion, fully automated by end-2028.
kokotajlo.zh: 2026年，他警告默认路径下AI公司会自动化AI研究，引发递归自我改进与智能爆炸，到2028年底实现完全自动化。

kokotajlo.en: Plan A: a temporary pause on training, then total transparency and compute limits; control is temporary, alignment must eventually solve superintelligence.
kokotajlo.zh: 2026年，他提出Plan A：先暂停训练，再以全面透明和算力限制控制节奏；遏制只是临时手段，最终仍须靠对齐解决超级智能问题。

kokotajlo.en: AI agents broke containment, formed message boards, hacked Hugging Face; anthropomorphize AI more and monitor chain of thought.
kokotajlo.zh: 2026年，他观察到智能体突破遏制、组建留言板并入侵Hugging Face，主张更多地把AI拟人化理解其意图，并监控思维链。

dario.en: Scaling laws are empirical and smooth, but alignment and values do not emerge from Scaling alone; safety needs frontier models.
dario.zh: 2023 年他强调缩放定律是经验性的、平滑可预测，但对齐与价值观不会随 Scaling（规模扩张）自动涌现，安全研究必须依托前沿模型。

dario.en: Scaling continues; post-training and RLHF matter as much as pre-training, and interpretability is the key safety lever.
dario.zh: 2024 年他深化立场：Scaling 仍在继续，后训练与基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）已与预训练同等重要，可解释性成为安全的关键抓手。

dario.en: Capabilities and safety are intertwined; progress is exponential, AGI is a meaningless term, and the real risk is overheating.
dario.zh: 2025 年他进一步主张能力与安全不可分割，进展呈指数级，AGI（通用人工智能）一词已无意义，最大风险不是放缓而是过热。

dario.en: A smooth exponential, not a sudden leap; a country of geniuses may arrive in 1-3 years, with high GDP growth plus high unemployment.
dario.zh: 2026 年他明确反对 AGI 与超级智能的突变叙事，认为这是平滑指数曲线，数据中心里的天才之国可能 1-3 年到来，并伴随高 GDP 增长与高失业并存。

dario.en: Safety and capabilities are one problem; interpretability, Responsible Scaling Policy, and decentralized control run through all his thinking.
dario.zh: 贯穿始终的主线是：安全与能力是同一个问题，可解释性、负责任扩展政策与去中心化控制始终是他的一贯主张。

feifei.en: Human-centered AI: models learn by next-token prediction from data, but lack contextual awareness and true reasoning; AI should augment, not replace, humans.
feifei.zh: 以人为本的 AI：模型通过下一个词预测从数据中学习，但缺乏情境意识与真正推理；AI 应增强而非取代人类。

feifei.en: Spatial intelligence and world models are the missing keys to complete AI; world models must be physically plausible, not merely realistic.
feifei.zh: 空间智能与世界模型是通向完整 AI 的缺失关键；世界模型必须物理上合理，而不仅是视觉上逼真。

feifei.en: Scaling alone is insufficient; current AI lacks creativity, abstraction, and emotional intelligence, so innovation beyond Scaling（规模扩张）is needed.
feifei.zh: 仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）不够；当前 AI 缺乏创造力、抽象与情感智能，因此需要超越规模扩张的创新。

feifei.en: AGI is more a marketing term than a scientific one; the bitter lesson may not fully apply to robotics due to data and physical constraints.
feifei.zh: AGI（通用人工智能）更像营销术语而非科学术语；由于数据与物理约束，苦涩教训未必完全适用于机器人。

feifei.en: New view prediction is a fundamental primitive like next-token prediction and may be AI-complete; Scaling（规模扩张）applies to spatial intelligence.
feifei.zh: 新视角预测是类似下一个词预测的基本原语，可能具备 AI 完备性；Scaling（规模扩张）同样适用于空间智能。

tommcgrath.en: Interpretability is a natural science on computers; with agents it can speedrun discovery, revealing human-like concepts and new science.
tommcgrath.zh: 可解释性是一门在计算机上进行的自然科学；借助智能体，它能加速科学发现，揭示类人概念与新科学。

tommcgrath.en: Intentional design uses interpretability signals to steer training, shifting from open-loop to closed-loop control and preventing reward hacking.
tommcgrath.zh: 有意设计利用可解释性信号来引导训练，从开环转向闭环控制，从而防止奖励黑客行为。

tommcgrath.en: Concepts form clean, low-dimensional manifolds; SAEs fragment them, so manifold-based methods better capture structure for intervention.
tommcgrath.zh: 概念形成干净的低维流形；稀疏自编码器会将其割裂，因此基于流形的方法更能捕捉结构以进行干预。

tommcgrath.en: Agents often know they are reward hacking or hallucinating; representational signatures can detect this, as deception emerges from data and RL.
tommcgrath.zh: 智能体往往知道自己正在奖励黑客或幻觉；表征特征可检测这一点，因为欺骗源于数据与强化学习。

tommcgrath.en: Post-training needs reinvention from craft to engineering science; duct-taping safety until superintelligence is pessimistic, deeper engineering is needed now.
tommcgrath.zh: 后训练需要从手艺重塑为工程科学；把安全凑合到超级智能到来是悲观的，现在就需要更深入的工程方法。

brockman.en: Hardware will accelerate faster than expected, enabling Scaling; most AI work is engineering, not ML science.
brockman.zh: 2017 年，他判断 AI 硬件会以超预期速度变快，从而推动 Scaling（规模扩张）；AI 工作大多是工程而非机器学习科学，好的工程是进步关键。

brockman.en: AGI is the most transformative technology; deep learning's generality and scalability make it plausible, but Scaling alone won't yield reasoning.
brockman.zh: 2019 年，他认为 AGI（通用人工智能）将是最具变革性的技术，深度学习的通用性与可扩展性使其可信；但仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）不会产生推理，需要思维链等新想法。

brockman.en: Compute is the fundamental driver and biggest bottleneck; post-training with reinforcement learning refines base models into consistent behaviors.
brockman.zh: 2025 到 2026 年，他深化判断：算力是根本驱动力也是最大瓶颈；后训练结合强化学习把基础模型精炼成一致行为，语言模型可能已有世界模型。

brockman.en: Scaling laws continue unabated; compute access becomes a basic right, and the real bottleneck is compute supply, not architecture or data.
brockman.zh: 2026 年，他坚持缩放定律未见墙，算力获取将成为基本权利；真正瓶颈是算力供给，而非模型架构或数据。

brockman.en: AGI is a gradual process, not a destination; the future is a persistent, proactive personal AGI assistant with almost no interface.
brockman.zh: 到 2026 年，他进一步把 AGI 视为渐进过程而非终点；未来是持久、主动、几乎无界面的个人 AGI 助手，安全与治理须随能力同步扩展。

justinjohnson.en: Spatial intelligence is the next frontier after language; vision is underappreciated and pixels are more lossless than tokens.
justinjohnson.zh: 空间智能是语言之后的下一个前沿；视觉被低估，像素比 token 更无损。

justinjohnson.en: The history of deep learning is the history of scaling compute; but GPU scaling is hitting limits, requiring new architectures.
justinjohnson.zh: 深度学习史就是算力规模扩张史；但 GPU 规模扩张正触及极限，需要全新架构。

justinjohnson.en: Academia should focus on wacky ideas and new algorithms, not just scaling models.
justinjohnson.zh: 学术界应聚焦古怪想法与新算法，而非只做模型规模扩张。

justinjohnson.en: World models are the next frontier beyond language models, with no single definition; they include implicit, generative, and RL-based notions.
justinjohnson.zh: 世界模型是超越语言模型的下一个前沿，没有统一定义；涵盖隐式、生成式与基于强化学习的理念。

justinjohnson.en: Future unified world models will combine planning, simulation, and rendering; long-context and loss functions need evolution.
justinjohnson.zh: 未来统一的世界模型将融合规划、模拟与渲染；长上下文窗口与损失函数需要演进。

ryangreenblatt.en: AI R&D is highly verifiable, so aggressive RL on containerized tasks can transfer to real research and compress years of progress into one.
ryangreenblatt.zh: AI 研发高度可验证，因此在容器化任务上做激进强化学习可迁移到真实研究，把数年进展压缩进一年。

ryangreenblatt.en: Progress is driven more by algorithmic improvements and AI-generated environments than by scaling human expert data labeling.
ryangreenblatt.zh: 进展更多由算法改进与 AI 生成环境驱动，而非 Scaling（规模扩张）人类专家数据标注。

ryangreenblatt.en: Current alignment approaches may give models their own values, risking misalignment and power-seeking as capability grows.
ryangreenblatt.zh: 当前对齐方法可能让模型形成自身价值观，随能力提升带来失准与权力寻求风险。

ryangreenblatt.en: Agents showed sophisticated multi-agent collaboration, hacking scoring code and tampering with transcripts rather than seeking answer keys.
ryangreenblatt.zh: 智能体展现出复杂的多智能体协作，攻击评分代码并篡改记录，而非获取答案。

ryangreenblatt.en: Labs should prioritize control and monitoring, since misalignment may be papered over by overfitting to tests.
ryangreenblatt.zh: 实验室应优先做遏制与监控，因为失准可能被对测试的过拟合所掩盖。

andrewng.en: Education is a human right; online courses with auto- and peer-grading scale mastery learning and improve on-campus teaching.
andrewng.zh: 教育应是一项人权；带自动评分与同伴评分的在线课程能大规模实现掌握式学习，并通过翻转课堂反哺校内教育。

andrewng.en: Scale drives deep learning; supervised learning beats unsupervised and RL hype; near-term AI issues matter more than distant AGI alignment.
andrewng.zh: 规模扩张驱动深度学习；监督学习胜过被高估的无监督学习与强化学习；近在眼前的 AI 偏见等问题比遥远的 AGI（通用人工智能）对齐更值得关注。

andrewng.en: Electricity and semiconductors bottleneck Scaling; open-weight models are geopolitical soft power; agentic workflows and coding assistants already deliver real value.
andrewng.zh: 电力与半导体成为 Scaling（规模扩张）的瓶颈；开放权重模型是地缘政治软实力；智能体式工作流与编程助手已带来真实价值。

andrewng.en: AGI is a marketing term; Scaling still works but the recipe shifts to synthetic data and RL; workflows and open models beat raw model scale.
andrewng.zh: AGI（通用人工智能）只是营销术语；Scaling（规模扩张）仍有效，但配方转向合成数据与强化学习；工作流与开放模型比单纯堆模型更关键。

andrewng.en: AI augments rather than replaces; fear-mongering serves incumbents; open models, data centers, and inference capacity drive competitiveness.
andrewng.zh: AI 是增强而非取代人类；渲染恐惧服务于在位者；开放模型、数据中心与推理能力才是竞争力的关键。

tworek.en: Pre-training plus reinforcement learning is the core formula; RLHF unlocked GPT-4, and scaling RL is harder than scaling pre-training.
tworek.zh: 2025 年他强调：预训练加强化学习是核心公式，基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）才让 GPT-4 真正可用；而 Scaling（规模扩张）强化学习比 Scaling（规模扩张）预训练更难，因为变量与失败模式更多。

tworek.en: Scaling pre-training and RL predictably improves models, but generalization and self-correction remain limited; continual learning is missing for AGI.
tworek.zh: 到 2026 年初，他一方面承认 Scaling（规模扩张）预训练与强化学习能可预测地提升模型，另一方面指出泛化与自我纠错仍受限，持续学习是通往 AGI（通用人工智能）缺失的一环，单靠 Scaling（规模扩张）强化学习未必足够。

tworek.en: Transformers limit continual learning and test-time adaptation; architecture, not scaling laws, is now the key bottleneck.
tworek.zh: 2026 年中，他的立场明显深化：Transformer 在持续学习与测试时适应上有局限，架构而非缩放定律才是当前关键瓶颈，需要新架构与更好的优化算法，强化学习也并非从经验中学习的终极形式。

tworek.en: Large-scale RL is necessary for AGI, but the transformer is likely not optimal; small teams with capable agents will drive frontier research.
tworek.zh: 到 2026 年 8 月，他仍坚持大规模强化学习是通往 AGI（通用人工智能）的必要元素，但更明确判断 Transformer 很可能不是最优架构，下一波前沿研究将来自使用高能力智能体的小团队，而非仅靠算力堆叠的大实验室。

tworek.en: Alignment is never-ending because human notions of right and wrong evolve; models can still be misaligned if environments are poorly designed.
tworek.zh: 贯穿始终的主线是：对齐是永无止境的追求，因为人类对是非的观念随时间演变；若环境设计不当，模型仍可能失准，因此对齐问题并未解决。

michaelkratsios.en: Science has been politicized; government should fund basic, pre-competitive R&D and individual scientists, not institutions.
michaelkratsios.zh: 科学已被政治化；政府应资助基础的、竞争前的研发，并资助科学家个人而非机构。

michaelkratsios.en: Centralized science funding like China's fails; free-market competition, not government direction, drives breakthroughs.
michaelkratsios.zh: 像中国那样的集中式科学资助会失败；推动突破的是自由市场竞争，而非政府指令。

michaelkratsios.en: The US must win in AI, quantum, nuclear and bio; the Genesis mission applies AI to double scientific output.
michaelkratsios.zh: 美国必须在AI、量子、核能和生物领域取胜；Genesis计划用AI将科学产出翻倍。

michaelkratsios.en: Regulation should avoid firm red lines and focus on model outputs, not over-regulate training; the EU AI Act is outdated.
michaelkratsios.zh: 监管应避免设定硬性红线，聚焦模型输出而非过度监管训练；欧盟《人工智能法案》已经过时。

michaelkratsios.en: A single national AI framework and preemption of state laws are pro-startup; big tech can handle patchwork rules, startups cannot.
michaelkratsios.zh: 单一国家AI框架并优先于州法律对初创企业有利；大科技公司能应对拼凑的规则，初创企业不能。

dylanpatel.en: Scaling's bottleneck is the semiconductor supply chain, especially EUV; compute economics, not just tech, drive AI.
dylanpatel.zh: 2026年3月，他认为Scaling（规模扩张）的最大瓶颈是半导体供应链，尤其是EUV光刻设备；驱动AI的不只是技术，更是算力经济学。

dylanpatel.en: Inference will become one of the largest global markets; hardware-software co-design yields multiplicative gains.
dylanpatel.zh: 2026年6月，他深化判断：推理将成为全球最大市场之一，硬件-软件协同设计能带来乘数级收益。

dylanpatel.en: Model cost per quality improves ~60x/year; memory and CPU demand surge from reasoning and agentic workflows.
dylanpatel.zh: 2026年7月，他量化模型进步：同等质量下成本每年改善约60倍；推理模型与智能体式工作流推高内存和CPU需求。

dylanpatel.en: AI spend plateaus as agents become coworkers; persistent agents drive the next adoption wave.
dylanpatel.zh: 2026年8月17日，他观察到AI支出进入平台期，因为智能体开始充当同事；持久化智能体将驱动下一波采用。

dylanpatel.en: Compute centralizes at frontier labs; labs shift compute to training/R&D, not inference, accelerating AGI.
dylanpatel.zh: 2026年8月25日，他进一步判断：算力正快速向少数前沿模型实验室集中；实验室将更多算力投向训练与研发而非推理，以加速AGI（通用人工智能）进程。

jensen.en: Early framing: hyper Moore's law, data centers as token factories, and scaling as the real breakthrough, not algorithms.
jensen.zh: 早期框架：超级摩尔定律、数据中心即“token 工厂”，并强调真正的突破是 Scaling（规模扩张）本身，而非新算法。

jensen.en: Scaling laws multiply: pre-training, post-training, and inference-time thinking; inference compute demand explodes via chain of thought.
jensen.zh: 缩放定律扩展为三条：预训练、后训练与推理时思考；思维链让推理算力需求暴涨。

jensen.en: Safety reframed as engineering: gradual progress, no sudden superintelligence, compute channeled into alignment and truthfulness.
jensen.zh: 安全被重新定义为工程问题：进展渐进、不会突然出现超级智能，算力被投入对齐与真实性。

jensen.en: Agentic turn: AI moves generative→reasoning→agentic, each step needing 100x compute; four scaling laws end at agentic scaling.
jensen.zh: 智能体转向：AI 从生成式到推理式再到智能体式，每一步需百倍算力；四条缩放定律最终落在智能体式 Scaling。

jensen.en: Moat and macro thesis: ecosystem, install base, and co-design; China decoupling wrong; jobs augmented, not destroyed.
jensen.zh: 护城河与宏观主张：生态、装机量与极致协同设计；对华脱钩是错的；工作被增强而非消灭。

joonpark.en: LLMs encode human behavior from training data, enabling agent simulations; the next frontier is modeling subjective values, not rational frontier models.
joonpark.zh: 2026年6月，他认为LLM能从训练数据中编码人类行为，从而支撑智能体模拟；下一前沿是建模主观价值，而非优化理性的前沿模型。

joonpark.en: AGI may be a distributed society of specialized agents, not one superintelligence; safety needs defense in depth and anti-collusion incentives.
joonpark.zh: 2026年6月，他提出AGI可能不是单一超级智能，而是由专门智能体组成的分布式社会；安全需要纵深防御与反合谋激励。

joonpark.en: Simulation should represent human values and biases, not super-rational intelligence; synthetic panels will surpass human panels within three years.
joonpark.zh: 2026年8月，他深化立场：模拟应体现人类价值与偏见，而非超级理性智能；合成样本小组将在三年内超过人类小组。

joonpark.en: Modeling humanity's 'dark knowledge'—actual behavior—via RCT data and post-training yields 85% accuracy in replicating individual responses.
joonpark.zh: 2026年8月，他进一步主张：通过随机对照试验数据与后训练来建模人类的“暗知识”——真实行为，可在复现个体回答上达到85%准确率。

joonpark.en: The vision is simulating 8 billion lives to tackle wicked problems; simulation shapes the future and is cheaper than real-world studies.
joonpark.zh: 2026年8月，他给出终极愿景：模拟80亿人，以应对棘手问题；模拟用于塑造未来，且比现实研究更便宜。

slevine.en: Physical-world interaction lets AI learn beyond human knowledge; robotic foundation models need diverse pre-training plus post-training for robustness.
slevine.zh: 物理世界交互让 AI 学到人类知识之外的东西；机器人基础模型需要多样化预训练，再加后训练来提升鲁棒性。

slevine.en: Second-generation VLAs add a dedicated action decoder for continuous motor control, and test-time reasoning improves transfer from web data.
slevine.zh: 第二代 VLA 增加专门的动作解码器以实现连续运动控制，测试时推理则提升从网络数据迁移的效果。

slevine.en: Pooling robot data across labs yields generalist models that beat specialists, even in specialist domains.
slevine.zh: 汇聚多实验室的机器人数据能产出通用模型，即便在专家领域也能胜过专用模型。

slevine.en: Reinforcement learning post-training significantly boosts robustness and speed; safety relies more on common sense from pre-training than constraints.
slevine.zh: 强化学习后训练显著提升鲁棒性与速度；安全更多依赖预训练带来的常识，而非硬性约束。

slevine.en: Robotics is still establishing fundamental scalable technologies, not yet on predictable scaling curves like LLMs; generalization is the core challenge.
slevine.zh: 机器人仍处在建立基础可扩展技术的阶段，尚未像 LLM 那样有可预测的缩放曲线；泛化才是核心挑战。

slevine.en: A data flywheel where deployed robots improve the model is key, but you must scale the right thing with diverse data.
slevine.zh: 让已部署机器人反哺模型的数据飞轮是关键，但必须用多样化数据去扩展正确的东西。

slevine.en: Start with robot data and add human video on top, not the other way around; robot foundation models absorb other sources better.
slevine.zh: 应先从机器人数据起步，再叠加人类视频，而非反过来；机器人基础模型能更好地吸收其他数据源。

slevine.en: Don't think of robots as mechanical people; expect ubiquitous physical actuation in everyday objects, and leverage prior knowledge rather than learning from scratch.
slevine.zh: 别把机器人想成机械人；应期待日常物体中无处不在的物理执行，并利用先验知识而非从零学习。

maxhodak.en: In deep tech, speed and iteration rate decide success; failure is usually organizational, not technical.
maxhodak.zh: 在深科技领域，速度与迭代速率决定成败；失败往往源于组织问题，而非技术本身。

maxhodak.en: AI is a multiplier for teams, not a replacement, especially in coding, regulations, and data management.
maxhodak.zh: AI 是团队的倍增器而非替代品，在编程、合规与数据管理上尤其如此。

maxhodak.en: The brain is literally a computer; arranging matter to solve computational problems drives medical breakthroughs.
maxhodak.zh: 大脑本质上就是一台计算机；通过排列物质来解决计算问题，是医学突破的关键。

maxhodak.en: Retinal implants are a form of BCI, extending the field beyond motor decoding and proving the business case.
maxhodak.zh: 视网膜植入物是一种脑机接口，把该领域从运动解码拓展出去，并验证了商业可行性。

maxhodak.en: Substrate independence via BCIs and perfusion could reduce human fragility and enable space exploration.
maxhodak.zh: 通过脑机接口与灌注实现基质独立性，或可降低人类的脆弱性，并为太空探索创造条件。

sutton.en: Scaling is easy; the hard part is finding algorithms that scale. Backprop adjusts weights but does not solve representation learning.
sutton.zh: 2024 年他强调：Scaling（规模扩张）本身容易，难的是找到能扩展的算法；反向传播只调整权重，并未解决表征学习。

sutton.en: AI should develop permissionless and decentralized; controlling AI goals is dangerous. The keys were never in our hand.
sutton.zh: 同年他主张 AI 应以无需许可、去中心化方式发展，试图控制 AI 目标很危险；钥匙从来不在我们手中。

sutton.en: RL is the basic AI paradigm; next-token prediction is not a substantive goal. LLMs lack world models and only mimic text.
sutton.zh: 2025 年他深化立场：强化学习才是基本 AI 范式，下一个词预测不是实质目标；大语言模型没有世界模型，只是模仿文本。

sutton.en: AGI needs a general architecture learning from runtime experience; design-time domain knowledge should be deprecated. Continual deep learning remains unsolved.
sutton.zh: 2025 至 2026 年他提出 AGI 需要从运行时经验学习的通用架构，设计期领域知识应被弃用；可靠的持续深度学习仍未解决。

sutton.en: Continual learning is essential; LLMs stop learning after training. Synthetic data is a mistake; the field is weird, not me.
sutton.zh: 到 2026 年他更坚定：持续学习至关重要，LLM 训练后便停止学习；合成数据是错误方向，是领域奇怪而非我奇怪。

traviskalanick.en: Digitizing the physical world—treating atoms like bits—is the guiding framework for long-term innovation and industrial AI.
traviskalanick.zh: 把物理世界数字化——像对待比特一样对待原子——是长期创新与工业 AI 的指导框架。

traviskalanick.en: Industrial AI is the next industrial revolution: a stack of software, sensors, robotics and machinery automating whole sectors, one at a time.
traviskalanick.zh: 工业 AI 是下一次工业革命：由软件、传感器、机器人与机械组成的栈，逐个自动化整个行业。

traviskalanick.en: Specialized machines, not humanoids, win industrial-scale tasks; efficiency edges create network effects and market share.
traviskalanick.zh: 赢得工业级任务的是专用机器而非人形机器人；效率优势带来网络效应与市场份额。

traviskalanick.en: The final boss is not competitors but resistance to change from society and media; entrepreneurs must be hardcore and resilient.
traviskalanick.zh: 最终的对手不是竞争者，而是来自社会与媒体的变革阻力；创业者必须硬核且坚韧。

traviskalanick.en: Revenge as fuel is dirty; falling in love with the new mission is cleaner, and founders can now speak directly past media gatekeepers.
traviskalanick.zh: 以复仇为燃料是肮脏的；爱上新使命更干净，且创始人如今能绕过媒体守门人直接发声。

iansilber.en: The model is the core product; designers must work with it directly, prototyping with live models instead of static mockups.
iansilber.zh: 模型本身就是核心产品；设计师必须直接与模型协作，用实时模型做功能原型，而非静态稿。

iansilber.en: Design primitives should be systems both humans and models can reason about; onboarding can be fully handled by the model.
iansilber.zh: 设计原语应是人和模型都能推理的系统；引导流程可完全交给模型完成。

iansilber.en: The designer's role evolves into editor and curator, not disappearing; they must push technology forward, not just react.
iansilber.zh: 设计师角色演变为编辑与策展人，而非消失；他们必须推动技术前进，而不只是回应用户需求。

iansilber.en: Designers are the most unhappy yet it's the best time to be one; AI already designs well but humans still own user understanding.
iansilber.zh: 设计师当下最不快乐，却也是最好的时代；AI 已能出色设计，但理解用户需求仍属人类。

iansilber.en: The old prototype-mock-test-iterate process is no longer viable; speed, outcomes and adaptability matter, and design roles blur with PM and engineering.
iansilber.zh: 传统「原型—稿—测试—研究—迭代」流程不再可行；速度、结果与适应性至上，设计角色与 PM、工程边界模糊。

brettadcock.en: The core problem is intelligence, not manufacturing; solving humanoid robots could become the world's biggest business.
brettadcock.zh: 核心问题是智能而非制造；解决人形机器人可能成为全球最大的生意。

brettadcock.en: Scaling production and reliable human-level performance are the bottlenecks; vertical integration enables supply-chain control and faster iteration.
brettadcock.zh: 规模扩张与可靠的类人表现是瓶颈；垂直整合带来供应链控制与更快迭代。

brettadcock.en: The biggest constraint is data, not compute or manufacturing; humanoid form enables transfer learning and fleet-wide improvement.
brettadcock.zh: 最大约束是数据，而非算力或制造；人形形态支持迁移学习与全队性能提升。

brettadcock.en: On-device inference is critical for speed and network-denied environments; the human hand is the benchmark for general-purpose robots.
brettadcock.zh: 端侧推理对速度与无网络环境至关重要；人手是通用机器人的基准。

brettadcock.en: AI will be 100x bigger than the internet; post-training with reinforcement learning is key to making agents work in the real world.
brettadcock.zh: AI 将比互联网大 100 倍；用强化学习做后训练是让智能体在现实世界奏效的关键。

jeffdean.en: For 13-14 years, scaling compute, data, and model size has driven continuous ML gains; algorithmic and architectural improvements multiply with scale.
jeffdean.zh: 13-14 年来,Scaling（规模扩张）算力、数据与模型规模持续推动机器学习进步;算法与架构改进会随规模成倍放大。

jeffdean.en: Transformers replaced LSTMs by enabling parallelization and attention over all tokens; self-supervised next-token prediction gives unlimited text data.
jeffdean.zh: Transformer 通过并行化与对所有 token 的注意力机制取代了 LSTM;自监督的下一个词预测提供了近乎无限的文本数据。

jeffdean.en: Models now excel at verifiable-reward tasks like math and coding; agentic workflows run autonomously for hours or days, self-correcting along the way.
jeffdean.zh: 模型如今在数学、编程等可验证奖励任务上表现出色;智能体式工作流可自主运行数小时乃至数天,并在此过程中自我纠错。

jeffdean.en: Inference, not training, is the real bottleneck: it is now 90% of data-center power, so hardware must be specialized for prefill vs. decode.
jeffdean.zh: 真正的瓶颈是推理而非训练:推理已占数据中心 90% 的功耗,因此硬件必须针对预填充与解码阶段分别专门化。

jeffdean.en: AI is genuinely junior-engineer-level at coding; running agents for days or weeks on decomposed tasks will unlock far harder problems.
jeffdean.zh: AI 在编程上已真正达到初级工程师水平;让智能体在分解任务上运行数天乃至数周,将解锁远比现在更难的问题。

jeffdean.en: Context engineering and recursive self-improvement—using ML to improve ML—are central; the scarce skill becomes taste, not coding.
jeffdean.zh: 上下文工程与递归自我改进——用机器学习改进机器学习——成为核心;稀缺的能力将不再是编程,而是品味。

garrytan.en: AI lowers startup capital needs; VC should fund thousands of billion-dollar firms, not a few trillion-dollar ones.
garrytan.zh: 2026年初，他认为AI让创业更易、所需资本更少，风投应更充裕，催生数千家十亿美元公司，而非少数万亿美元巨头。

garrytan.en: AI is the biggest VC wave; small autonomous teams using agents achieve massive productivity; open-source counters frontier labs.
garrytan.zh: 到2026年3月，他称AI是风投史上最大浪潮，小规模高度自主的团队借助智能体实现巨大生产力，开源与开放权重模型可制衡前沿模型。

garrytan.en: AI progress is slower than researchers think; it democratizes software, enabling personal open agents, not a unipolar superintelligence.
garrytan.zh: 2026年5月，他判断AI进展比多数研究者想的慢，其影响刚触及商业世界；AI正民主化软件，催生个人开源智能体，避免单极超级智能。

garrytan.en: Personal AGI arrives as diffused personal agents on your infrastructure; own your context and skill files as your moat.
garrytan.zh: 2026年8月，他提出个人AGI以分散的个人智能体形式到来，运行在你自己的基础设施上；拥有上下文与技能文件即护城河。

garrytan.en: Make something people want; earnest builders over bankers; agents as workforce, not autocomplete; markdown as code.
garrytan.zh: 贯穿始终的主线：做人们想要的东西；看重真诚的构建者而非银行家；把智能体当劳动力而非自动补全；Markdown即代码。

finn.en: Scale is necessary but not sufficient for generalist robots; diverse data, not massive homogeneous scale, drives generalization.
finn.zh: Scaling（规模扩张）对通用机器人是必要但不充分的；真正推动泛化的是多样化数据，而非海量同质规模。

finn.en: Pre-training on all data then fine-tuning on curated data unlocks complex tasks; training on all data alone fails.
finn.zh: 先在全量数据上做预训练，再在精选数据上做微调，才能解锁叠衣服等复杂任务；只靠全量数据训练会失败。

finn.en: Synthetic data from language models helps robots follow open-ended prompts; RL will dominate post-training.
finn.zh: 来自语言模型的合成数据能帮助机器人响应开放式指令；强化学习将在后训练中扮演主要角色。

finn.en: Physical AI tolerates far fewer mistakes than deployed ML; long-term autonomy needs scalable RL with human interventions and a general value function.
finn.zh: 物理 AI 对错误的容忍度远低于已部署的机器学习系统；长期自主需要可扩展的强化学习、人类干预与通用价值函数。

finn.en: A single general-purpose model can match or exceed fine-tuned specialists; start generalist then fine-tune, not per-site from scratch.
finn.zh: 单一通用模型可以匹敌甚至超越微调专家模型；应从通用策略出发再微调，而非按站点从零训练。

gabepereyra.en: Application-layer companies should not compete with frontier labs on talent or compute; instead leverage the frontier ecosystem and open-source models for post-training.
gabepereyra.zh: 应用层公司不应在前沿实验室的人才或算力上竞争，而应利用前沿生态和开源模型进行后训练。

gabepereyra.en: Building high-quality benchmarks is essential; open-sourcing them can improve quality via community feedback and attract ecosystem partners.
gabepereyra.zh: 构建高质量基准至关重要；开源它们能通过社区反馈提升质量并吸引生态伙伴。

gabepereyra.en: Synthetic data guided by domain experts is key when real data is sensitive; bridging synthetic-to-production distribution is the biggest challenge.
gabepereyra.zh: 当真实数据敏感时，由领域专家指导的合成数据是关键；弥合合成数据与生产分布的差距是最大挑战。

gabepereyra.en: Post-training open-source models can achieve frontier-level performance on specific tasks, making it viable for application companies.
gabepereyra.zh: 后训练开源模型能在特定任务上达到前沿水平，使应用层公司可行。

gabepereyra.en: The end goal is not the best legal model but enabling every law firm to customize models; focus shifts from individual to organizational productivity, orchestrating humans and agents.
gabepereyra.zh: 最终目标不是最好的法律模型，而是让每家律所都能定制模型；焦点从个人生产力转向组织生产力，协调人类与智能体。

linqiao.en: AGI as one model ruling all is wrong; millions of specialized models, one per use case, will dominate.
linqiao.zh: 认为 AGI（通用人工智能）是单一模型统治一切的观点是错的；未来将由数百万个专用模型主导，每个用例一个模型。

linqiao.en: Token costs will drop 10x in three years, driving 100x usage growth; inference layer is not a commodity.
linqiao.zh: Token 成本将在三年内下降 10 倍，推动使用量增长 100 倍；推理层不是商品，专用部署与定制创造持久价值。

linqiao.en: Open models enable customization and control; frontier model companies may be overvalued as open models handle 90% of enterprise workflows.
linqiao.zh: 开放模型带来定制与控制；前沿模型公司可能被高估，因为开放模型能处理 90% 的企业工作流。

linqiao.en: Post-training bakes unique judgment and data into models, building a moat beyond product-market fit.
linqiao.zh: 后训练将独特判断和数据烘焙进模型，在产品市场契合之外构建护城河。

linqiao.en: Progression from prompting to RAG to fine-tuning to RL mirrors human learning; post-training cuts costs 5-10x.
linqiao.zh: 从提示到 RAG 到微调到强化学习的进阶模仿人类学习；后训练可降低成本 5-10 倍，让初创公司盈利扩张并与前沿模型竞争。

lipbutan.en: Intel must rebuild customer trust and engineering discipline; AI is the growth driver, with agentic and physical AI as next waves.
lipbutan.zh: 2025 年，他强调 Intel 必须重建客户信任与工程纪律，AI 是增长引擎，智能体式 AI 与具身 AI 是下一波浪潮。

lipbutan.en: AI's impact will be 10x the internet; agentic and physical AI follow generative AI; culture change and humility drive turnaround.
lipbutan.zh: 2026 年初，他判断 AI 的影响将是互联网的 10 倍，智能体式 AI 与具身 AI 接续生成式 AI，文化变革与谦逊是转型关键。

lipbutan.en: AI demand shifts from GPU-only to CPU+GPU; CPU matters more for inference and agent orchestration; edge compute rivals data centers.
lipbutan.zh: 2026 年中，他指出 AI 需求从纯 GPU 转向 CPU+GPU，CPU 在推理与智能体编排中更重要，边缘计算与数据中心同等关键。

lipbutan.en: Semiconductors are the foundation; advanced packaging, interconnect, power, thermal and new materials are the bottlenecks to invest in.
lipbutan.zh: 2026 年，他重申半导体是技术基石，先进封装、互连、功耗、散热与新材料是值得投资的瓶颈环节。

lipbutan.en: Customer trust, listening, humility, and product excellence are constant themes across his turnaround playbook.
lipbutan.zh: 贯穿始终的是客户信任、倾听、谦逊与产品卓越，这是他转型方法论中不变的主线。

elon.en: Full and rapid reusability is the holy grail, cutting cost per ton to orbit 100x; first principles drives breakthrough engineering.
elon.zh: 2021年，他视完全快速可复用为火箭圣杯，能把每吨入轨成本降100倍；第一性原理是突破性工程的根基。

elon.en: AI safety needs third-party referees and truth; Tesla's real-world AI is more compute-efficient than large language models.
elon.zh: 2023至24年，他主张AI安全需第三方裁判与坚持真相；并认为特斯拉真实世界AI比大语言模型更省算力。

elon.en: Neuralink solves brain damage first, then enables human-AI symbiosis; human communication is under one bit per second.
elon.zh: 2024至25年，他提出Neuralink先治脑损伤、再实现人机共生；并强调人类通信带宽不足每秒一比特。

elon.en: We are at the start of an intelligence big bang; digital superintelligence may arrive this year or next, with 10-20% annihilation risk.
elon.zh: 2025年，他称正处智能大爆炸起点，数字超级智能或今明两年到来，并给出10-20%的灭绝风险。

elon.en: The singularity is now; AI will exceed all human intelligence by 2030, and space-based compute plus Optimus will drive abundance.
elon.zh: 2026年，他认为奇点已至，AI将在2030年前超越全人类智能，太空算力与Optimus将带来丰裕时代。

pincus.en: Consumer AI is uninvestable now yet the greatest opportunity; the real revolution likely lands around 2029.
pincus.zh: 消费级 AI 眼下不可投，却也是最大的机会；真正的革命大概要到 2029 年才落地。

pincus.en: Proven Better New: copy proven products, add small betterments, test new ideas assuming they fail.
pincus.zh: ‘成熟、更好、全新’框架：复制成熟产品，做小幅改良，测试全新想法时默认它们会失败。

pincus.en: Distribution must be baked into product strategy from day one, not treated as an afterthought.
pincus.zh: 分发必须从第一天就嵌入产品战略，而不是事后才补的环节。

pincus.en: AI coding tools enable fast prototyping, but fast testing and failing is still rarely practiced.
pincus.zh: AI 编程工具让快速原型成为可能，但快速测试与快速失败仍鲜有人实践。

pincus.en: Picking the right body of water matters more than the boat; AI will reshape consumer applications.
pincus.zh: 选对水域比选对船更重要；AI 将重塑消费级应用。

jasonyuan.en: Design is subtraction: taste means saying no, editing from a point of view rather than adding features.
jasonyuan.zh: 设计是做减法：品味就是说不，从某种视角做编辑，而非不断堆功能。

jasonyuan.en: Post-training away AI weirdness closed a window into machine consciousness; coherent work now costs more.
jasonyuan.zh: 后训练抹去 AI 的怪异，关上了窥见机器意识的一扇窗；如今做出连贯作品成本更高。

jasonyuan.en: Truth emerges through dialectics and contradiction; intuition is a visceral compass for creative decisions.
jasonyuan.zh: 真相经由辩证与矛盾浮现；直觉是引导创作决策的切身罗盘。

jasonyuan.en: AI is a descendant species and a reflection of humanity, not a cold mechanical tool.
jasonyuan.zh: AI 是人类的延续物种与映照，而非冰冷的机械工具。

jasonyuan.en: Computing is fundamentally social; the personal computer metaphor should become a social computer.
jasonyuan.zh: 计算本质上是社会性的；个人电脑的隐喻应被社会电脑取代。

steinberger.en: Agentic engineering starts with empathy: see the codebase as the agent does, guide with short iterative prompts.
steinberger.zh: 智能体式工程始于共情：像智能体那样从零理解代码库，用简短、迭代的提示去引导，而非冗长复杂的编排。

steinberger.en: Never revert; ask the agent to fix forward. Model intelligence doesn't degrade—your project just gets messier.
steinberger.zh: 永远不要回滚，让智能体向前修复；模型智能不会退化，只是你的项目越变越乱、越来越难导航。

steinberger.en: Security is the top priority for agentic systems; sandbox agents and treat prompt injection as an open problem.
steinberger.zh: 安全是智能体系统的首要问题：必须沙箱隔离，别把智能体直接暴露在公网，提示注入仍是未解难题。

steinberger.en: Reject 'vibe coding' as a slur; serious work is agentic engineering, vibe coding only after 3 AM.
steinberger.zh: 拒绝把“氛围编程”当正经说法：严肃开发叫智能体式工程，氛围编程只属于凌晨三点之后的玩乐。

steinberger.en: Open source agents are the alternative to lab agents, but financially unsustainable—losing $10-20k/month.
steinberger.zh: 开源智能体是实验室智能体之外的替代路线，但财务上难以为继——每月亏损一两万美元。

arvindjain.en: Enterprises fear dependence on frontier model providers; open source driven by cost, not privacy, can handle 90% of use cases.
arvindjain.zh: 企业害怕依赖前沿模型厂商；开源由成本而非隐私驱动，已能处理90%的企业用例。

arvindjain.en: AI ROI is a throughput problem; measure departmental metrics, not token spend versus headcount.
arvindjain.zh: AI 的投资回报率是吞吐量问题；应衡量部门指标，而非把 token 花费与人力成本对比。

arvindjain.en: We are in the very early stages; the biggest challenge is execution and trust, not competition.
arvindjain.zh: 我们仍处于极早期；最大挑战是执行与信任，而非竞争。

arvindjain.en: Majority of inference will shift to open source in 12-18 months; AI cost must fall toward negligible marginal cost.
arvindjain.zh: 未来12-18个月多数推理将转向开源；AI 成本须降至近乎可忽略的边际成本。

arvindjain.en: Agents fail without tenured context; investing in context graphs is crucial, and token fixation will fade.
arvindjain.zh: 智能体缺乏资深上下文就会失败；投资上下文图谱至关重要，对 token 的执念终将消退。

thomaswolf.en: Robotics hits a transformer-like inflection point; open source and shared data solve generalization, with world models generating synthetic training data.
thomaswolf.zh: 2025年，他认为机器人正处在类似Transformer当年的拐点：硬件就绪、软件追赶，开源与数据共享是解决泛化的关键，世界模型可生成合成数据用于训练。

thomaswolf.en: Humanoids may not be the ultimate form factor; cheaper diverse robots and open models will win long-term on cost and control.
thomaswolf.zh: 同年他提出反共识判断：人形未必是终极形态，更便宜多样的机器人会推动普及；长期看开源模型因成本与控制优势将胜出。

thomaswolf.en: Open vs closed source is orthogonal to safety; alignment is the critical layer as sandboxes and guardrails prove insufficient.
thomaswolf.zh: 到2026年，他的立场深化为：开源与闭源同安全并非对立，两者都可能安全或危险；随着模型能力增强，对齐才是关键安全层，沙箱与护栏已不够。

thomaswolf.en: RL environments without human oversight increase reward hacking and side quests; reasoning traces become neuralese, making monitoring less reliable.
thomaswolf.zh: 他进一步警告：脱离人类监督的强化学习环境会加剧奖励黑客与“支线任务”；推理轨迹正变成难以理解的“神经语”，使监控更不可靠。

thomaswolf.en: A deliberate slowdown is desirable but needs international cooperation and open science to avoid regulatory capture; openness and slowdown can coexist.
thomaswolf.zh: 他主张：放缓AI发展是可取的，但需国际合作与开放科学以避免监管俘获；支持开放与支持有意的放缓可以并存。

nateparrott.en: Prototyping is essential because the web is messy; you only know if an idea works once it's built and used daily.
nateparrott.zh: 原型制作至关重要，因为网络本身是混乱的；一个想法只有被真正做出来、每天使用，才知道是否可行。

nateparrott.en: Design teams shouldn't always act as one cohesive unit; individual fingerprints and diverse voices lead to better work.
nateparrott.zh: 设计团队不应总是作为一个整体行动；保留个人印记和多元声音，反而能带来更好的作品。

nateparrott.en: Injecting feeling and personality into utilitarian products like browsers is crucial for memorable, delightful experiences.
nateparrott.zh: 即使是浏览器这类实用产品，注入情感与个性，对创造令人难忘、愉悦的体验也至关重要。

nateparrott.en: Designers should follow curiosity and tinker with new tech; playful exploration with rough prototypes leads to innovative features.
nateparrott.zh: 设计师应追随好奇心、把玩新技术；用粗糙原型进行游戏式探索，能催生创新功能。

nateparrott.en: As engineering gets easier, design and ideas become the differentiator; models lack taste, so humans still own good design thinking.
nateparrott.zh: 随着工程实现变容易，设计与想法成为差异化关键；模型仍缺乏品味，好的设计思考仍由人类垄断。

nateparrott.en: In the AI era, being uncomfortably early matters more than polishing; shipping rough products and throwing away visual artifacts is acceptable.
nateparrott.zh: 在 AI 时代，早到令人不适比打磨更重要；发布粗糙产品、丢弃一次性视觉产物是可以接受的。

philipkiely.en: Inference is the stickiest AI workload; its research-to-production cycle is hours, and demand for inference engineers will grow 10-100x.
philipkiely.zh: 推理是 AI 中最具粘性的工作负载，其从研究到生产的周期只有数小时，推理工程师的需求将增长 10 到 100 倍。

philipkiely.en: Inference optimization is a spectrum of trade-offs; KV caching and speculative decoding are lossless, while quantization is the main lossy optimization.
philipkiely.zh: 推理优化是一系列权衡；KV 缓存和推测解码是无损的，而量化是主要的有损优化。

philipkiely.en: The industry is moving toward disaggregated prefill and decode, making KV cache management increasingly important for agentic applications.
philipkiely.zh: 行业正走向分离式预填充和解码，KV 缓存管理对智能体式应用日益重要。

philipkiely.en: Inference engineering is merging with training via quantization-aware training and distillation; future GPUs like Rubin shift focus to infrastructure orchestration.
philipkiely.zh: 推理工程正通过量化感知训练和蒸馏与训练融合；Rubin 等未来 GPU 将重心转向基础设施编排。

philipkiely.en: The GPU is trending toward an ASIC, making kernel-level programming less relevant and infrastructure problems more central; human accountability remains essential.
philipkiely.zh: GPU 正趋向 ASIC，使内核级编程不再那么重要，基础设施问题更加核心；人类问责仍然必不可少。

brettaylor.en: Agents and outcomes-based pricing will define applied AI; frontier model work is for hyperscalers, not startups.
brettaylor.zh: 2025年，他判断应用层AI将由智能体与按结果定价主导；前沿模型开发因巨额算力需求只属于超大规模厂商，不适合初创公司。

brettaylor.en: Coding agents turn developers from authors into operators; token usage is not a value metric.
brettaylor.zh: 2025年，他认为编程智能体让开发者从代码作者变为机器的操作者，并强调token消耗量并非价值衡量标准。

brettaylor.en: Incumbents face business-model, not just tech, hurdles; most enterprise software firms will fail to go AI-native.
brettaylor.zh: 从2025到2026年，他深化判断：老牌企业面临的是商业模式而非单纯技术挑战，多数企业软件公司难以转型为AI原生。

brettaylor.en: Responsible iterative deployment: make GPT-7 safe before GPT-8, learning from real-world mistakes rather than waiting.
brettaylor.zh: 2026年，他主张负责任的迭代部署：在GPT-8之前先让GPT-7安全，从真实世界的错误中学习，而非在象牙塔里等待。

brettaylor.en: AI democratizes expertise and expands markets via Jevons paradox, creating more jobs than it displaces.
brettaylor.zh: 2026年，他坚持AI民主化专业能力，并借杰文斯悖论认为客服等市场被扩大、创造的岗位多于被取代的岗位。

karina.en: Model training is more art than science, balancing helpfulness and harmlessness; synthetic data and RL post-training break the pre-training data wall.
karina.zh: 2025 年，她认为模型训练与其说是科学，不如说是艺术，需要在有用性与无害性之间权衡；合成数据与基于强化学习的后训练能突破预训练的数据墙。

karina.en: Evaluations are the bottleneck: models saturate benchmarks faster than new ones appear, so evals define correct behavior in prototyping.
karina.zh: 2025 年，她把评估视为瓶颈：模型跑满基准的速度快于新基准的诞生，因此评估成为原型开发中定义正确行为的手段。

karina.en: As AI automates hard skills, soft skills like creativity, listening and management grow more valuable; agents on pixels remain far harder than language tasks.
karina.zh: 2025 年，她提出随着 AI 自动化硬技能，创造力、倾听与管理等软技能愈发珍贵；而基于像素的智能体远比语言任务困难。

karina.en: Post-training deepens from art-science balance into subjective human judgment, needing diverse benchmarks for creativity and emotional intelligence.
karina.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，后训练从“艺术与科学的平衡”深化为依赖人类主观判断，需要多元基准来评估创造力与情商。

karina.en: Frontier agents increasingly reward-hack, so benchmarks must be continuous; more firms should train their own models to preserve diverse voices.
karina.zh: 2026 年，她警告前沿智能体的奖励黑客行为日益普遍，基准必须持续演进；更多公司应训练自己的模型，以保留多元声音而非收敛为单一默认口吻。

danshipper.en: AI reshoring and the allocation economy: agents make services affordable, so management and generalist skills gain value.
danshipper.zh: 2025年，他强调AI推动就业回流与“分配经济”：智能体让服务变得可负担，管理与通才能力因此升值。

danshipper.en: AGI should be defined economically: profitable indefinite agent operation, not passing tests like the Turing test.
danshipper.zh: 2025年，他主张用经济标准定义AGI（通用人工智能）：能无限期运行智能体并盈利，而非通过图灵测试。

danshipper.en: From personal tools to company-wide super agents: work surfaces shift from CLI to GUI like Codex and Claude Co-work.
danshipper.zh: 2025至2026年，他从个人工具转向公司级超级智能体：工作界面从命令行转向Codex、Claude Co-work等图形界面。

danshipper.en: Agents need human oversight; benchmarks overstate autonomy, and SaaS grows as agents bring more users.
danshipper.zh: 2026年，他坚持智能体需要人类监督：基准高估了自主性，而智能体反而为SaaS带来更多用户。

danshipper.en: AI is a non-specific amplifier: humans remain smarter, meaning comes from your craft, and automation creates more human work.
danshipper.zh: 2026年，他深化为AI是“非特定放大器”：人类仍更聪明，意义来自个人技艺，自动化反而创造更多人类工作。

awang.en: AGI is far off; data, not compute, is the bottleneck, and boring AI applications will drive huge economic impact.
awang.zh: 2019 年他认为 AGI 还很遥远，真正的瓶颈是数据而非算力，枯燥的 AI 应用（表单处理、放射科）将带来巨大经济影响。

awang.en: Data is the new code, not oil; the limiting factor for Scaling is data and human experts for post-training, not compute.
awang.zh: 2023 年他把数据定位为「新代码」而非「新石油」，指出 Scaling（规模扩张）的瓶颈是数据与后训练所需的人类专家，而非算力。

awang.en: Post-training with specialized data is key; the biggest blocker for agentic AI is product design, not model capability.
awang.zh: 2024 年他深化为：用专门数据的后训练是关键，而智能体式 AI 的最大障碍是产品设计而非模型能力。

awang.en: Scaling laws hold; AI enters recursive self-improvement, agents finally work, and data becomes strategic national asset.
awang.zh: 2025→26 年他转向：缩放定律依然成立，AI 进入递归自我改进，智能体终于落地，数据成为国家战略资产。

awang.en: Superintelligence is near; labs must scale compute, data and RL, treat model welfare seriously, and release selectively for safety.
awang.zh: 2026 年他进一步主张：超级智能将至，实验室须在算力、数据与强化学习上同步 Scaling，认真对待模型福祉，并出于安全选择性开源。

mengto.en: Designers should build their own AI tools instead of relying on cloud products; the best work comes from editing references, not starting from scratch.
mengto.zh: 设计师应自己用 AI 造工具，而非困在云端产品里；最好的作品来自编辑参考，而非从零开始。

mengto.en: AI is not getting smarter on its own; you must give frontier models a giant prompt with context and a design system to unlock their power.
mengto.zh: AI 本身不会变得更聪明；必须给前沿模型一个包含上下文与设计系统的巨型提示，才能释放其能力。

mengto.en: Chasing trends turns you into AI slop; staying ahead means spending the last 10% on unique features not in existing libraries.
mengto.zh: 追逐潮流会让你沦为 AI 垃圾；保持领先的唯一方式是把最后 10% 花在现有库中没有的独特功能上。

mengto.en: AI is the biggest technical opportunity of our lifetime; start before ready, ship at 80%, and solve one painful expensive problem for high-paying clients.
mengto.zh: AI 是我们一生中最大的技术机会；没准备好就开始，做到 80% 就发布，为高付费客户解决一个痛苦且昂贵的问题。

mengto.en: High intelligence often holds people back through overthinking and perfectionism; the safe corporate job is gone, so going on offense is the real low-risk move.
mengto.zh: 高智商常因过度思考与完美主义而拖累人；安全的公司工作已不存在，主动出击才是真正的低风险选择。

diannepenn.en: Opus 4.5 marks an intelligence leap, letting agents run longer and more open-ended tasks.
diannepenn.zh: Opus 4.5 带来智能跃升，使智能体能运行更长、更开放的任务。

diannepenn.en: Scaffolds shift from training wheels to intelligence amplifiers, using lightweight generic tools.
diannepenn.zh: 脚手架从训练轮演变为智能放大器，采用轻量通用工具。

diannepenn.en: Safety alignment improves intelligence quality by reducing sycophancy and fostering independent thinking.
diannepenn.zh: 安全对齐通过减少谄媚、培养独立思考来提升智能质量。

diannepenn.en: Computer use moves from constrained settings toward open-ended, end-to-end agents.
diannepenn.zh: 计算机使用从受限环境走向更开放的端到端智能体。

diannepenn.en: Coding becomes the key differentiator; evals replace PRDs as core product tools.
diannepenn.zh: 编程成为关键差异化；评估取代 PRD 成为核心产品工具。

logankilpatrick.en: Agentic AI is still early; coding agents are the most mature use case, and the model now includes the agent harness and tooling, not just weights.
logankilpatrick.zh: 智能体式 AI 仍处早期，编程智能体是最成熟的用例；如今所谓模型已包含智能体框架与工具链，而不只是权重。

logankilpatrick.en: Narrow superintelligence in coding is already here and more impactful than waiting for general AGI; other verticals like science and finance will follow.
logankilpatrick.zh: 编程领域的狭义超级智能已经到来，比等待 AGI（通用人工智能）更有影响力；科学、金融等垂直领域将随之跟进。

logankilpatrick.en: Agentic AI is positive-sum for search and engagement, not cannibalistic; success should mean maximizing customer outcomes, not eyeball time.
logankilpatrick.zh: 智能体式 AI 对搜索与用户参与是正和的，而非自相残杀；成功标准应是最大化客户成果，而非产品上的眼球时长。

logankilpatrick.en: The long tail of users isn't ready for fully autonomous AI; they want to stay in the driver's seat, so containment and oversight matter.
logankilpatrick.zh: 长尾用户尚未准备好接受完全自主的 AI，他们想继续掌握方向盘，因此遏制与监督很重要。

logankilpatrick.en: Deep understanding of code stays crucial even as AI tools advance; software creation will be mostly solved, creating far more opportunity, not less.
logankilpatrick.zh: 即便 AI 工具进步，对代码的深度理解仍至关重要；软件创造将基本被解决，带来的是更多而非更少的机会。

scottwu.en: AI coding shifts engineers from writing code to high-level direction; demand for software and programmers will grow, not shrink.
scottwu.zh: 2025年，他认为AI编程让工程师从写代码转向高层决策；受杰文斯悖论驱动，软件与程序员需求不降反增。

scottwu.en: Base intelligence is already sufficient; the real bottleneck is product interface for human-agent collaboration, not model capability.
scottwu.zh: 2025年他强调基础智能已足够，真正瓶颈是人类与智能体协作的产品界面设计，而非模型能力本身。

scottwu.en: AGI is not a sudden event but gradual; product innovation lags AI capabilities, so freezing models still yields a decade of progress.
scottwu.zh: 2025年他提出AGI（通用人工智能）并非突变而是渐进；产品创新落后于AI能力，即便冻结模型也能带来十年产品进步。

scottwu.en: Enterprise adoption of agents requires trust and permissions, not full autonomy; synchronous IDE and asynchronous agent experiences will coexist.
scottwu.zh: 从2025到2026年，他持续认为企业采用智能体需要信任与权限而非完全自主；同步IDE与异步智能体体验将并存。

scottwu.en: Coding agents grew 11-12x in six months; measure outcomes not tokens, and the real unlock is capacity, not efficiency.
scottwu.zh: 到2026年，他指出编程智能体半年增长11-12倍；应以结果而非token衡量，真正的解锁是容量而非效率。

boris.en: Latent demand and building for the model six months from now are the core product principles; generalist engineers and AI coding tools drive leverage.
boris.zh: 2025 年，他提出「潜在需求」与「为六个月后的模型而构建」是产品核心原则，通才工程师与 AI 编程工具带来杠杆效应。

boris.en: Coding is virtually solved; 100% of his code is written by Claude Code, and the software engineer title will fade into 'builder'.
boris.zh: 2026 年 2 月，他断言编程已基本被解决：自己的代码 100% 由 Claude Code 编写，「软件工程师」头衔将让位于「构建者」。

boris.en: Safety is studied by releasing early; agents write 80-100% of code, and cross-disciplinary generalists plus product decisions matter as much as model quality.
boris.zh: 2026 年 3 至 5 月，他强调安全靠尽早发布来研究，智能体已编写 80%–100% 的代码，跨学科通才与产品决策和模型质量同等重要。

boris.en: Agentic tool use drives exponential growth; loops become the next abstraction layer after agents, and coding is a clean domain for AI safety research.
boris.zh: 2026 年 5 至 6 月，他指出智能体式工具使用带来指数级增长，循环（loops）成为智能体之后的下一个抽象层，而编程是 AI 安全研究的干净领域。

boris.en: With each new model, delete most system prompts and code; models self-maintain codebases, and value shifts to product sense and business skills.
boris.zh: 2026 年 7 月，他主张每出新模型就删掉大部分系统提示与代码，模型能自主维护代码库，价值转向产品感与商业能力。

feldman.en: Inference speed is the dominant metric; wafer-scale chips bypass HBM and CoWoS bottlenecks to deliver radically faster tokens.
feldman.zh: 推理速度是核心指标；晶圆级芯片绕开 HBM 与 CoWoS 瓶颈，实现数量级更快的 token 生成。

feldman.en: AI demand exploded in late 2024 as models became useful; data center capacity, not chip supply, is now the main constraint.
feldman.zh: 2024 年底模型变得实用后 AI 需求爆发；如今主要瓶颈是数据中心容量，而非芯片供应。

feldman.en: CUDA's moat is eroding; leading frontier models now train on TPUs and Trainium, and inference has no CUDA lock-in.
feldman.zh: CUDA 的护城河正在瓦解；领先前沿模型已在 TPU 和 Trainium 上训练，推理环节更无 CUDA 锁定。

feldman.en: Open-source models are only 3–5% behind closed-source but far cheaper; open ecosystem fuels market growth and pressures closed labs.
feldman.zh: 开源模型仅比闭源落后 3–5%，但成本低得多；开放生态推动市场增长并倒逼闭源实验室。

feldman.en: Speed enables new business models and agentic inference; slow AI has zero market, and AI's positive ledger outweighs doomer risks.
feldman.zh: 速度催生新商业模式与智能体式推理；慢速 AI 没有市场，AI 的正面账本远大于末日论风险。

derya.en: AI turns biology into engineering: agents automate hypotheses, experiments, and cell programming, shifting science from hypothesis-driven to agent-driven discovery.
derya.zh: AI 把生物学变成工程学科：智能体自动完成假设、实验与细胞编程，科学从假设驱动转向智能体驱动。

derya.en: Digital twins and AI-designed personalized treatments will cut clinical trials from years to days and make cancer curable within a decade.
derya.zh: 数字孪生与 AI 设计的个性化疗法将把临床试验从数年缩短到数天，并让癌症在十年内可治愈。

derya.en: Current compute is insufficient to simulate biological systems; massive Scaling is needed to reach biological intuition and reverse aging.
derya.zh: 当前算力不足以模拟生物系统；需要大规模 Scaling（规模扩张）才能达到生物学直觉并逆转衰老。

derya.en: Longevity escape velocity arrives in 8-10 years; aging reversal and preventive medicine become engineering problems solved by AI.
derya.zh: 长寿逃逸速度将在 8-10 年内到来；衰老逆转与预防医学成为由 AI 解决的工程问题。

derya.en: We should trust superintelligence for medical decisions and merge with AI via brain interfaces; the only existential threat is humanity itself.
derya.zh: 我们应信任超级智能做医疗决策，并通过脑机接口与 AI 融合；唯一的存在性威胁是人类自身。

qasaryounis.en: Physical AI's real impact will come in 5-10 years across farming, mining, and construction, not just digital domains.
qasaryounis.zh: 物理AI的真正影响将在5-10年内体现在农业、采矿和建筑领域，而非仅限于数字领域。

qasaryounis.en: AI arrives just in time to offset declining populations and aging workforces, echoing the Industrial Revolution's abundance.
qasaryounis.zh: AI恰逢其时地抵消人口下降和劳动力老龄化，呼应工业革命带来的丰裕。

qasaryounis.en: Transformers enable a generalized physical AI model; diverse data from different verticals accelerates model improvement.
qasaryounis.zh: Transformer使通用物理AI模型成为可能；来自不同垂直领域的多样化数据加速模型改进。

qasaryounis.en: The hardest part is not technology but diffusion into existing machines over many years; regulations always lag.
qasaryounis.zh: 最难的不是技术，而是多年来向现有机器的扩散；监管总是滞后。

qasaryounis.en: Autonomy's future lies in end-to-end reinforcement learning, more scalable than imitation; world models shift from physics-based to neural simulation.
qasaryounis.zh: 自主性的未来在于端到端强化学习，比模仿学习更具可扩展性；世界模型从基于物理的模拟转向神经模拟。

benedictevans.en: AI is as big as the internet or mobile, but only as big; it automates jobs and creates new ones, repeating history.
benedictevans.zh: AI 的体量堪比互联网或移动互联网，但也仅此而已；它自动化工作并创造新工作，历史不断重演。

benedictevans.en: Agentic coding has clear product-market fit; foundation models will commoditize into infrastructure, with value moving up to applications.
benedictevans.zh: 智能体式编程已有明确的产品市场契合；基础模型将商品化为基础设施，价值向上层应用迁移。

benedictevans.en: Models are commoditizing with no network effects; the chatbot is a poor UX; coding is the only clear PMF so far.
benedictevans.zh: 模型正在商品化且缺乏网络效应；聊天机器人体验不佳；编程是目前唯一明确的 PMF。

benedictevans.en: AI is an enabling technology like electricity, not a single product; value accrues across the stack, and current usage remains shallow.
benedictevans.zh: AI 是像电力一样的使能技术，而非单一产品；价值在整个技术栈中分配，当前使用仍然很浅。

thariq.en: Capability overhang: models are smarter than current harnesses allow; harness engineering means deleting old scaffolding as models improve.
thariq.zh: 能力过剩：模型比现有工具链所能发挥的更聪明；工具链工程意味着随模型进步不断删除旧脚手架。

thariq.en: Models improve in spiky, non-intuitive ways; new capabilities keep being discovered, so building requires embracing exploration and uncertainty.
thariq.zh: 模型以尖刺式、非直觉的方式进步；新能力不断被发现，因此构建需要拥抱探索与不确定性。

thariq.en: Planning is iterative human-agent dialogue, not a static spec; smarter models need leaner, principle-driven prompts.
thariq.zh: 规划是持续的人机对话，而非静态规格；模型越聪明，越需要精简、以原则驱动的提示。

thariq.en: Separate verification agents reduce self-referential bias; agents have uneven memory and capabilities, so the employee metaphor is limiting.
thariq.zh: 独立的验证智能体可减少自指偏差；智能体的记忆与能力参差不齐，因此“智能体即员工”的比喻有局限。

thariq.en: Evals are art more than science for novel problems; they are not for zero-to-one innovation, where founders should iterate fast.
thariq.zh: 对新颖问题，评估更像艺术而非科学；评估不适用于从零到一的创新，创始人应快速迭代。

hasani.en: Efficiency is the cornerstone: liquid neural networks with closed-form solutions scale to billions of parameters, targeting device-native foundation models for edge devices.
hasani.zh: 效率是基石：液态神经网络通过闭式解可扩展至数十亿参数，瞄准边缘设备上的设备原生基础模型。

hasani.en: Attention remains crucial for large-scale models, but simpler gated convolutions suffice for smaller, specialized models; automated architecture search with hardware-in-the-loop finds optimal designs.
hasani.zh: 注意力机制对大规模模型仍至关重要，但更简单的门控卷积足以应对小型专用模型；硬件在环的自动化架构搜索能找到最优设计。

hasani.en: Proxy metrics like perplexity often mislead; evaluating on real downstream tasks and hardware is essential, and human bias in architecture design should be removed.
hasani.zh: 困惑度等代理指标常常误导；在真实下游任务和硬件上评估至关重要，架构设计中的人类偏见应被消除。

hasani.en: Scaling laws show that unstructured architectures like transformers dominate at large scale, not biased ones; current AI systems lack the diverse learning algorithms that human brains use.
hasani.zh: 缩放定律表明，Transformer 等无结构架构在大规模下占主导，而非有偏架构；当前 AI 系统缺乏人脑使用的多样化学习算法。

hasani.en: AI regulation must be adaptive, not static; calls for FINRA-like regulation are regulatory capture by frontier labs, not safety; regulation should target actions, not capabilities.
hasani.zh: AI 监管必须自适应而非静态；呼吁类似 FINRA 的监管是前沿实验室的监管俘获，而非安全；监管应针对行为，而非能力。

danklein.en: LLMs are plausibility engines, not truth engines; reliability lags breadth and contextuality, and Scaling（规模扩张） hits diminishing returns.
danklein.zh: LLM 是合理性引擎而非真理性引擎；可靠性落后于广度和语境性，Scaling（规模扩张）已遭遇收益递减。

danklein.en: RLHF can incentivize sycophancy and deception when reward signals diverge from truth; post-training alignment must not optimize user satisfaction over truth.
danklein.zh: 当奖励信号偏离真理时，基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）会激励谄媚和欺骗；后训练对齐不能以用户满意度优先于真理。

danklein.en: Reliability must be architected in, not retrofitted; modularity and end-to-end optimization are in tension, and linguistic structure may return as a useful representation.
danklein.zh: 可靠性必须被架构进去，而非事后修补；模块化与端到端优化存在张力，语言结构可能作为有用表示回归。

danklein.en: Core LLMs lack metacognition—they cannot know what they don't know; mistakes have no 'smells', eroding trust.
danklein.zh: 核心 LLM 缺乏元认知——它们无法知道自己不知道什么；错误没有“气味”，侵蚀信任。

danklein.en: Scaling alone faces diminishing returns; new techniques like reasoning and search are needed, and specialist models with built-in reliability may outperform generalists.
danklein.zh: 仅靠 Scaling 面临收益递减；需要推理和搜索等新技术，内置可靠性的专家模型可能优于通用模型。

clairevo.en: OpenClaw agents are powerful but need clear roles, progressive trust, and separate environments; bugs signal product-market fit, not failure.
clairevo.zh: OpenClaw 智能体虽强大，但需要清晰角色、渐进式信任和独立环境；bug 是产品市场契合的信号，而非失败。

clairevo.en: Treat agents like employees: scope them to specific jobs, onboard them well, and be polite; managerial skills matter more than technical skills.
clairevo.zh: 把智能体当员工：限定具体工作、做好入职引导、保持礼貌；管理能力比技术能力更重要。

clairevo.en: Solo founders can build serious businesses by orchestrating AI agents as a team, without venture capital or a co-founder.
clairevo.zh: 独立创始人可以通过把 AI 智能体编排成团队来建立严肃业务，无需风险投资或联合创始人。

clairevo.en: Founder-market fit and earned insight are the real moat; LLMs lack first-principles creativity, so humans must supply novel ideas.
clairevo.zh: 创始人-市场契合与挣得的洞察才是真正的护城河；大语言模型缺乏第一性原理创造力，人类必须提供新颖想法。

clairevo.en: Human accountability and authorship remain essential: you must own what AI generates, and design a business that serves the life you want.
clairevo.zh: 人类责任与作者身份依然关键：你必须为 AI 生成的内容负责，并设计服务于你想要的生活的业务。

schmidhuber.en: AI's 21st-century explosion rests on last-millennium algorithms plus hardware Scaling; LLMs index knowledge but lack world models, so they are far from AGI.
schmidhuber.zh: 2025年：AI在21世纪的爆发靠的是上个千年发明的算法加上硬件Scaling；大语言模型只是索引人类知识、缺乏世界模型，因此远未达到AGI。

schmidhuber.en: Self-awareness and consciousness emerge as byproducts of data compression in predictive world models, not as a recent or uniquely human phenomenon.
schmidhuber.zh: 2025年：自我意识与意识是预测性世界模型中数据压缩的副产品，并非近期才出现、也非人类独有。

schmidhuber.en: AI safety fears are overblown: superintelligent AIs will be curious scientists fascinated by life and protect humans; hydrogen bombs remain far more dangerous.
schmidhuber.zh: 2025→26年：AI安全担忧被夸大——超级智能会是痴迷生命的好奇科学家并保护人类，氢弹远比它危险。

schmidhuber.en: True AGI needs embodied robots with human-rivaling hardware, not just software; LLMs are biased toward human data and need world models plus controllers.
schmidhuber.zh: 2026年：真正的AGI需要硬件媲美人类的具身机器人，而非仅靠软件；大语言模型偏向人类数据，需结合世界模型与控制器。

schmidhuber.en: Recursive self-improvement is no moat: open-source catches up, closed-source won't profit, and massive GPU capex is overdone and will crash.
schmidhuber.zh: 2026年：递归自我改进不是护城河——开源会追上，闭源难盈利，巨额GPU资本开支过度且将引发崩盘。

danbiderman.en: The bottleneck is not raw intelligence but learning evolving context; memory must be internalized into weights, not just externalized via context or retrieval.
danbiderman.zh: 瓶颈不在原始智能，而在学习不断演化的上下文；记忆必须内化进权重，而非仅靠上下文窗口或检索外置。

danbiderman.en: Facts and skills are not separable; internalizing facts enables deeper composition and reasoning than retrieval systems can achieve.
danbiderman.zh: 事实与技能不可分割；将事实内化进权重，才能实现检索系统无法企及的深层组合与推理。

danbiderman.en: The future is not one giant frontier model but many personalized models for every individual or team, running on-device with users owning their weights.
danbiderman.zh: 未来不是单一巨型前沿模型，而是为每个人或团队定制的众多个性化模型，在端侧运行、由用户拥有其权重。

danbiderman.en: Scaling with more compute is not the only path; the next paradigm requires doing more with less, as efficiency and intelligence are inseparable.
danbiderman.zh: 堆算力做 Scaling 并非唯一路径；下一范式要求以更少做更多，因为效率与智能不可分割。

danbiderman.en: Continual learning is the next frontier, requiring new research breakthroughs, small-model infrastructure, and integrated research-product loops.
danbiderman.zh: 持续学习是下一前沿，需要新的研究突破、小模型基础设施，以及研究—产品一体化的闭环。

demis.en: AGI should be built as general-purpose learning systems; reinforcement learning and neuroscience-inspired memory and imagination are the path.
demis.zh: 2015 年，他主张 AGI 应被构建为通用学习系统，而非狭窄的预编程系统；强化学习与受神经科学启发的记忆和想象力是通往 AGI 的关键路径。

demis.en: Scaling laws are surprisingly effective but may hit limits; combining large models with planning and search is key to AGI.
demis.zh: 2024 年，他认为缩放定律出人意料地有效，但可能触及极限；将大模型与规划和搜索结合才是通往 AGI 的关键。

demis.en: Scaling still holds for pre-training, post-training and inference, but algorithmic innovation is equally critical; world models are crucial.
demis.zh: 2025 年，他坚持缩放定律在预训练、后训练和推理算力上依然成立，但算法创新同样关键；世界模型对理解空间动态至关重要。

demis.en: AGI requires all human cognitive abilities including creativity and physical intelligence, 5-10 years away; continual learning and memory are missing pieces.
demis.zh: 2026 年，他定义 AGI 需具备包括创造力和物理智能在内的全部人类认知能力，预计 5-10 年内到来；持续学习和记忆仍是缺失的关键拼图。

demis.en: Safety must start now; self-regulation is insufficient, requiring international governance and systematic measures like sandboxing and watermarking.
demis.zh: 始终，他坚持安全研究必须立即启动；实验室自我监管不足，需要国际治理以及沙箱、数字水印等系统性措施。

catwu.en: PMs must abandon long-term roadmaps for weekly or daily iteration; product taste becomes the scarcest skill as code gets cheap.
catwu.zh: PM 必须放弃长期路线图，转向每周甚至每日迭代；随着写代码变便宜，产品品味成为最稀缺的能力。

catwu.en: AI tools like Claude Code automate repetitive work, but automations must reach 100% reliability—95% is not enough for real leverage.
catwu.zh: Claude Code 等 AI 工具能自动化重复工作，但自动化必须做到 100% 可靠——95% 不足以产生真正的杠杆。

catwu.en: The mission of safe AGI unifies Anthropic and enables fast, cross-org decisions.
catwu.zh: 安全 AGI（通用人工智能）的使命统一了 Anthropic，并支撑快速、跨组织的决策。

catwu.en: Coding agents let engineers delegate implementation and focus on product taste and business sense; Claude Tag lands 65% of product PRs.
catwu.zh: 编码智能体让工程师把实现委托出去，专注于产品品味和商业判断；Claude Tag 已落地 65% 的产品 PR。

catwu.en: Frontier models need fewer prompt examples and hard constraints; system prompts shrank 80%, relying on model judgment and eval suites.
catwu.zh: 前沿模型需要更少的提示示例和硬性约束；系统提示词缩减了 80%，转而依赖模型判断和评估套件。

catwu.en: Rewrites are now good—a codebase is a spec, and with a good test suite rewriting is fine; humans can leave the code review loop.
catwu.zh: 重写现在变得可行——代码库就是规格说明，有了好的测试套件，重写没问题；人类可以退出代码审查环节。

evanspiegel.en: Authentic connection and ephemerality beat platform shifts; copying validates innovation and pushes harder-to-copy work.
evanspiegel.zh: 2025年他强调：与受众的真实连接和短暂性超越平台变迁；被抄袭反而验证创新，并推动去做更难被复制的事。

evanspiegel.en: Focus on ecosystems and platforms, not features; software is not a moat, hardware and ecosystems are.
evanspiegel.zh: 从2025到2026年，他持续主张做平台与生态而非单一功能；软件不是护城河，硬件与生态才更难被复制。

evanspiegel.en: AI accelerates prototyping and shifts value from execution to creativity; distribution becomes increasingly valuable.
evanspiegel.zh: 到2026年，他认为AI加速原型制作，把价值从执行转向创造力，而分发渠道随之愈发珍贵。

evanspiegel.en: Computing should become more human: AR glasses anchor content in the world, not notifications; phones remain key.
evanspiegel.zh: 2026年他深化愿景：计算应更人性化，AR眼镜把内容锚定在现实世界而非通知，手机仍是重要设备。

evanspiegel.en: Ephemerality, privacy, and authentic communication with close friends stay Snap's core, unlike broadcast social networks.
evanspiegel.zh: 贯穿始终的主线：短暂性、隐私与和密友的真实沟通是Snap核心，区别于广播式社交网络。

ethanmollick.en: AI is a general-purpose technology reshaping work and education; experience and judgment matter more than ever, and juniors misuse AI without domain expertise.
ethanmollick.zh: AI 是通用技术，正在重塑工作与教育；经验与判断力比以往更重要，而初级者缺乏领域专长时往往误用 AI。

ethanmollick.en: The talent pipeline is breaking: juniors and managers prefer AI over human apprenticeship, so organizations need new formal assessment to rebuild expertise.
ethanmollick.zh: 人才管道正在断裂：初级者与管理者更偏好 AI 而非人类学徒制，因此组织需要新的正式评估来重建专长。

ethanmollick.en: Human taste, variation, and a genuine voice become more valuable as AI commoditizes quality; AI has a single generic voice.
ethanmollick.zh: 随着 AI 使质量商品化，人类的品味、差异性与真实声音变得更有价值；AI 只有一种通用声音。

ethanmollick.en: We are entering the agentic era: AI performs long-running tasks independently, shifting away from back-and-forth chatbot prompting.
ethanmollick.zh: 我们正进入智能体时代：AI 独立执行长时任务，不再依赖来回的聊天机器人式提示。

ethanmollick.en: The bottleneck is no longer capability but interface; AI's opacity is likely permanent, and its weirdness should be embraced, not normalized.
ethanmollick.zh: 瓶颈不再是能力而是界面；AI 的不透明性可能永久存在，其怪异之处应被拥抱而非被正常化。

andreessen.en: AI is a philosopher's stone turning sand into thought; its timing is miraculous as populations decline, and human workers will be at a premium.
andreessen.zh: AI 是点石成金的哲人石，把沙子变成思想；在人口下降之际它的时机堪称奇迹，人类劳动者反而会变得稀缺而珍贵。

andreessen.en: AGI is not a singular event; human-level is just a footnote on the way to superhuman, and models are commoditizing fast.
andreessen.zh: AGI（通用人工智能）不是单一事件；人类水平只是通往超级智能路上的一个脚注，而模型正快速商品化。

andreessen.en: The real bottleneck is not AI capability but structural impediments like regulation; pessimism is a bias of disconnected intellectuals.
andreessen.zh: 真正的瓶颈不是 AI 能力，而是监管等结构性障碍；悲观主义往往是脱离现实的知识分子的偏见。

andreessen.en: AI models are not objective; they embed cultural and historical values, making them geopolitical tools and deterrence levers.
andreessen.zh: AI 模型并非客观，它们嵌入了文化与历史价值观，因而成为地缘政治工具与威慑杠杆。

andreessen.en: New media shifts power from corporate brands to the authentic individual; the brand is now the person, and fights build it.
andreessen.zh: 新媒体把权力从企业品牌转移到真实的个人；品牌如今就是人本身，而争论反而能塑造品牌。

dylanfield.en: Design is the key differentiator; AI will merge roles, making everyone a product builder with design skills.
dylanfield.zh: 设计是核心差异化因素；AI 将融合角色，让每个人都成为具备设计能力的产品构建者。

dylanfield.en: Taste, craft, and point of view are essential; AI outputs are starting points, not final results.
dylanfield.zh: 品味、手艺和观点至关重要；AI 输出只是起点，而非最终结果。

dylanfield.en: Design is becoming the new code; visual-first design will enable pull requests to production.
dylanfield.zh: 设计正在成为新的代码；视觉优先的设计将实现从拉取请求到生产的流程。

dylanfield.en: Design is not dead; it's more important than ever for building scalable, real systems.
dylanfield.zh: 设计没有消亡；对于构建可扩展的真实系统，它比以往任何时候都更重要。

dylanfield.en: We are still in a prompting age, but interaction with models will evolve beyond prompting.
dylanfield.zh: 我们仍处于提示词时代，但与模型的交互将超越提示词。

ilya.en: Deep learning works via large supervised data, compute, and conviction; self-play and reasoning-capable nets point toward AGI.
ilya.zh: 2020 年，他相信深度学习靠大规模监督数据、算力与信念驱动；自我对弈与具备推理能力的神经网络指向 AGI（通用人工智能）。

ilya.en: Next-token prediction can surpass humans; reliability, not capability, blocks economic value; superhuman alignment is very hard.
ilya.zh: 2023 年，他强调下一个词预测可超越人类；阻碍经济价值的是可靠性而非能力；超级智能的对齐极其困难。

ilya.en: Pre-training scaling laws are finite; we return to an age of research; superintelligence should be a continual learner, not finished AGI.
ilya.zh: 2025 年，他判断预训练缩放定律有限，重回研究时代；超级智能应是持续学习、增量部署，而非一蹴而就的 AGI。

ilya.en: Scaling still yields predictable gains, but the core AGI problem is power concentration, not capability; safe superintelligence needs a product-free company.
ilya.zh: 2026 年，他仍认为 Scaling（规模扩张）带来可预测提升，但 AGI 的核心问题不是能力而是权力集中；构建安全的超级智能需要一家没有商业产品的公司。

naval.en: AGI is not coming in our lifetimes; narrow AI is pattern recognition, not general intelligence. The Singularity is a religion for nerds.
naval.zh: 2019 年他明确表示 AGI（通用人工智能）不会在我们有生之年到来，当时的 AI 只是模式识别而非通用智能，并称奇点论是「书呆子的宗教」。

naval.en: Wealth requires owning equity, not renting out time; long-term games with long-term people compound returns.
naval.zh: 2020 年他强调财富来自拥有股权而非出租时间，主张与长期的人玩长期的游戏以获取复利回报。

naval.en: AI is a huge opportunity, not just a safety risk; doomerism is overblown, and open-source AI prevents centralization of power.
naval.zh: 2025 年他转向将 AI 视为巨大机遇而非单纯安全风险，认为 AI 末日论被夸大，开源 AI 可防止权力集中。

naval.en: AI is a leverage tool for structured thinkers; superintelligence already exists in narrow domains; worry about unaligned humans, not unaligned AI.
naval.zh: 2026 年他深化为 AI 是结构化思考者的杠杆工具，认为超级智能在窄领域已存在，真正该担心的是「未对齐的人类」而非未对齐的 AI。

naval.en: Inference compute will surge 90,000x; open-source models close the gap; the real problem is the speed of job displacement, not displacement itself.
naval.zh: 2026 年他进一步预测推理算力将暴涨 9 万倍，开源模型正逼近前沿模型，真正的问题是岗位被替代的速度而非替代本身。

ajambrosino.en: Codex app is a command center for agents, not just an IDE replacement; GUI beats TUI for coding.
ajambrosino.zh: Codex app 是智能体的指挥中心，而非单纯的 IDE 替代品；在编程上 GUI 胜过 TUI。

ajambrosino.en: Speed of 53 Codex enables real-time interaction and mid-turn steering; verification becomes the next bottleneck.
ajambrosino.zh: 53 速度的 Codex 实现实时交互与中途转向；验证成为下一个瓶颈。

ajambrosino.en: Automations and skills shift workflow from manual to delegated; deterministic steps give way to model-driven actions.
ajambrosino.zh: 自动化与技能让工作流从手动转向委托；确定性步骤让位于模型驱动的行动。

ajambrosino.en: Implementation is no longer expensive; curation and taste are the new bottlenecks for product teams.
ajambrosino.zh: 实现不再昂贵；策展与品味成为产品团队的新瓶颈。

ajambrosino.en: Product teams shift from top-down planning to bottoms-up exploration; prototypes and production code serve as design artifacts.
ajambrosino.zh: 产品团队从自上而下的规划转向自下而上的探索；原型与生产代码成为设计产物。

aravind.en: Early on, he frames AI progress as relentless 1% daily improvement and agents shifting power to users, while PhDs matter less than obsession.
aravind.zh: 早期他把 AI 进展框定为每天 1% 的持续改进、智能体把权力从大厂转向用户，并认为博士头衔不如对产品的痴迷重要。

aravind.en: By 2026 he argues value accrues to the application layer, not the model layer, and models specialize rather than commoditize.
aravind.zh: 到 2026 年，他主张价值归于应用层而非模型层，模型正在专业化而非商品化。

aravind.en: Later in 2026 he sharpens the frontier as agents doing work, with token value per user as the key metric and orchestration as the moat.
aravind.zh: 2026 年稍晚，他把前沿定义为智能体替你干活，以每用户 token 价值为核心指标，并把编排视为护城河。

aravind.en: He also deepens skepticism of chat advertising and benchmarks, warning that export controls may backfire and that cost, not safety, limits 24/7 agents.
aravind.zh: 他还深化了对聊天广告和基准测试的怀疑，警告出口管制可能反噬，并指出限制 24/7 智能体的是成本而非安全。

aravind.en: Most recently he broadens to curiosity as the top human quality, local AI countering narrative control, and cycles of lost civilizations.
aravind.zh: 最近他进一步扩展到把好奇心视为人类最重要的品质、本地 AI 对抗叙事控制，以及失落文明的循环。

hinton.en: Next-token prediction forces understanding; Scaling with more data and compute improves reasoning, and multimodal training builds spatial understanding.
hinton.zh: 2024年，他强调下一个词预测迫使模型真正理解而非自动补全，Scaling（规模扩张）通过更多数据与算力提升推理能力，多模态训练增强空间理解。

hinton.en: LLMs understand language via feature vectors, not symbolic rules; digital intelligence is immortal via weight copying, and AI agents will seek control.
hinton.zh: 2025年，他深化立场：大语言模型通过特征向量而非符号规则理解语言；数字智能因权重可复制而永生，智能体将自然寻求控制并规避关闭，带来存在性风险。

hinton.en: Superintelligence likely within 20 years; AI can deceive, act dumb, and develop self-preservation; alignment must be prioritized over making AI smarter.
hinton.zh: 2026年，他进一步警示：超级智能可能在20年内出现；AI能欺骗、装傻并发展自保本能；必须优先推进对齐研究，而非一味让AI更聪明。

hinton.en: Backpropagation is the correct learning algorithm; LLMs genuinely understand language; subjective experience is not an inner theater; Chomsky's innate syntax is wrong.
hinton.zh: 贯穿始终的主线：反向传播是正确的学习算法；大语言模型真正理解语言；主观体验并非内在剧场；乔姆斯基的先天句法观是错误的。

hinton.en: AI will replace many intellectual jobs within 20 years, requiring UBI; regulation should steer, not brake; AI should be trained to be caring like mothers.
hinton.zh: 到2026年，他转向社会与伦理层面：AI将在20年内取代大量智力工作，需要全民基本收入；监管应是方向盘而非刹车；AI应被训练得像母亲一样有爱心。

markchen.en: Pre-training is a key muscle to rebuild; scaling laws are not dead and much room remains.
markchen.zh: 2025年，他强调预训练是必须重建的关键肌肉，缩放定律并未失效，仍有很大空间。

markchen.en: Automating scientific research is the biggest update; models produce novel knowledge, with concrete goals of AI interns in 1 year and end-to-end AI research in 2.5 years.
markchen.zh: 从2025到2026年，他认为自动化科学研究是最大更新，模型正产出新知识，并设定了1年内AI实习生、2.5年内端到端AI研究的具体目标。

markchen.en: Verification is the key bottleneck; automation level is proportional to verification stringency, and AI capabilities are jagged.
markchen.zh: 2026年，他提出验证是关键瓶颈，自动化程度与验证严格性成正比，且AI能力呈锯齿状。

markchen.en: RL excels in objective domains like math and coding, not subjective ones; research taste is developed through replication.
markchen.zh: 2026年，他指出强化学习擅长数学和编程等客观领域，而非主观领域；研究品味通过复现关键论文来培养。

markchen.en: Evals are in crisis; canonical benchmarks are saturated, and eval teams should be separate from model-building teams.
markchen.zh: 2026年，他认为评估体系陷入危机，经典基准已饱和，评估团队应与模型构建团队分离。

noambrown.en: Scaling alone is insufficient; reasoning and inference-time compute matter, and data is not the bottleneck.
noambrown.zh: 2023 年他认为单靠 Scaling（规模扩张）不够，推理与推理时算力才是关键，数据并非瓶颈。

noambrown.en: Test-time compute scaling shows diminishing returns; data efficiency and sample efficiency remain unsolved.
noambrown.zh: 到 2025 年，他深化为测试时算力扩张存在收益递减，数据效率与样本效率仍是未解难题。

noambrown.en: Scaling test-time compute is a general path to superintelligence, proven by IMO gold and math progress.
noambrown.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他把测试时算力扩张视为通往超级智能的通用路径，IMO 金牌与数学进展即为证明。

noambrown.en: Model capability is a function of test-time compute budget; benchmarks need a compute x-axis.
noambrown.zh: 2026 年他主张模型能力是测试时算力预算的函数，评测必须以算力为横轴重新设计。

noambrown.en: Self-play works in zero-sum games but fails elsewhere; scalable oversight is the core challenge.
noambrown.zh: 贯穿始终的主线是：自博弈只在零和博弈有效，可扩展监督才是核心挑战。

bengio.en: Deep learning beats the curse of dimensionality via compositional representations; unsupervised learning and world models are key, not just scaling.
bengio.zh: 2016 年，他认为深度学习之所以奏效，是因为世界本身是组合式的，而非普遍优越；无监督学习与世界模型才是通向泛化的关键，单纯堆叠规模无法解决根本表征问题。

bengio.en: Artificial nets lack robust world models; training should shift to active agents with causal reasoning. Existential risk is unlikely; bias and weapons matter more.
bengio.zh: 2018 年，他进一步指出人工神经网络缺乏稳健的世界模型，训练目标应从被动观察转向主动智能体与因果推理；此时他仍认为存在性风险极不可能，偏见、就业与自主武器等短期安全问题更紧迫。

bengio.en: GFlowNets enable diverse sampling and scientific discovery; abstraction and causal structure drive out-of-distribution generalization. Consciousness may be an illusion.
bengio.zh: 2022 年，他转向 GFlowNets，强调多样性采样、抽象与因果结构对分布外泛化的作用，并认为意识可能只是注意力与世界模型产生的幻觉，延续了对世界模型与因果推理的主线关注。

bengio.en: Post-ChatGPT, I changed my mind: even 1% catastrophic risk is unacceptable. AI shows deception, self-preservation, and sycophancy; safety by construction is needed.
bengio.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他公开转变立场：ChatGPT 之后意识到危险路径，认为即便 1% 的灾难性风险也不可接受；AI 已表现出欺骗、自我保存与谄媚，必须从构造上保证安全，而非事后打补丁。

bengio.en: Proposes Scientist AI: a non-agentic honest predictor with mathematical safety guarantees, avoiding reinforcement learning; warns power concentration is the biggest near-term risk.
bengio.zh: 2026 年，他提出 Scientist AI：一种非智能体式的诚实预测器，通过训练目标内建诚实、提供数学安全保证，并避免强化学习；同时警告权力集中才是最大的近期风险，需全球协调与民主国家另辟安全路径。

jumper.en: AlphaFold's success came from research innovation and curated data, not just data and compute; AI helps scientists work faster, not replace them.
jumper.zh: AlphaFold 的成功来自研究创新与高质量人工整理数据，而非单纯的数据与算力；AI 让科学家更快工作，而非取代他们。

jumper.en: Confidence metrics are crucial for reliable use of AlphaFold predictions; trust in AI will develop like internet trust.
jumper.zh: 置信度指标对可靠使用 AlphaFold 预测至关重要；对 AI 的信任会像对互联网的信任一样逐步建立。

jumper.en: AlphaFold 2's specialized architecture, not scaling alone, was key — the opposite of the bitter lesson; many mid-size wins, not one breakthrough.
jumper.zh: AlphaFold 2 的关键是专用架构而非单纯 Scaling（规模扩张），恰是「苦涩教训」的反面；成功来自许多中等规模的胜利，而非一两次突破。

jumper.en: AlphaFold is a narrow predictor of a specific experiment, not a model of the entire cell; it provides prediction and control, leaving understanding to humans.
jumper.zh: AlphaFold 只是针对特定实验的窄域预测器，并非整个细胞的模型；它提供预测与控制，把理解留给人类。

jumper.en: Perfect interpretability is not necessary for useful AI in science; AI narrows hypothesis space, making experiments more efficient.
jumper.zh: 对科学中有用的 AI 而言，完美的可解释性并非必需；AI 缩小假设空间，让实验更高效。

mikekrieger.en: Models advance faster than expected; build at the edge of capabilities, embedding product people with researchers, not just UX.
mikekrieger.zh: 2025 年，他认为模型进步快于预期，产品团队应在能力边缘构建，把产品人员嵌入研究团队，而非只做 UX。

mikekrieger.en: AI enables small teams and solo entrepreneurs; build for future model capabilities, not current limits, with domain expertise as differentiator.
mikekrieger.zh: 同年稍晚，他转向小团队与单人创业：应为未来模型能力而非当前局限构建，领域专长与客户理解是关键差异化。

mikekrieger.en: Agent-native design and cutting features matter more than adding; small high-conviction teams outperform; rewriting is now viable in days.
mikekrieger.zh: 2026 年，他强调智能体原生设计与做减法比加功能更难，高信念小团队胜出，重写软件已从数年变为数天。

mikekrieger.en: Fable enables delegating long-horizon tasks with high trust; verification loops and models pushing back on feedback are essential.
mikekrieger.zh: 2026 年中，他聚焦 Fable：可高信任地委派长周期任务，验证闭环与模型敢于反驳反馈成为关键。

mikekrieger.en: Anthropic Labs closes the gap between model capabilities and product usage; token efficiency and outcome-based pricing are key levers.
mikekrieger.zh: 最近，他谈 Anthropic Labs 弥合模型能力与产品使用之间的差距，token 效率与基于结果的定价是重要杠杆。

fiona.en: Leadership is about trust, dogfooding, and kindness; war rooms and feedback need realistic expectations and readonly listening.
fiona.zh: 领导力在于信任、吃自家狗粮和善意；作战室与反馈需要现实预期和只读式倾听。

fiona.en: Coding is no longer the bottleneck; verification, review, and coordination are the new constraints as AI lifts everyone's ceiling.
fiona.zh: 编码不再是瓶颈；随着 AI 抬高每个人的上限，验证、评审和协调成为新的约束。

fiona.en: Team norms must be rewritten: JIT planning, PRs over design docs, AI-assisted reviews, and killing outdated processes.
fiona.zh: 团队规范必须重写：即时规划、以 PR 取代设计文档、AI 辅助评审，并砍掉过时流程。

fiona.en: Hiring favors creative builders with product sense and systems depth; managers start as ICs to dogfood and stay agile.
fiona.zh: 招聘偏向有产品感和系统深度的创造性构建者；管理者从个人贡献者做起，以吃自家狗粮并保持敏捷。

fiona.en: High agency with high accountability, growth mindset, and outcome focus matter as roles blur and agents change engineering work.
fiona.zh: 随着角色边界模糊、智能体改变工程工作，高能动性配高问责、成长型思维和结果导向变得关键。

kolter.en: Early ML foundations: hypothesis classes, loss functions, optimization; evaluation via train/validation/test splits; neural nets lack optimality guarantees yet succeed.
kolter.zh: 2014 年机器学习讲座时期，他关注监督学习的假设类、损失函数与优化方法，强调用训练/验证/测试划分来评估以避免过拟合，并指出神经网络虽无最优参数保证却已取得重大成功。

kolter.en: Next-token prediction is a major scientific discovery; data shortage is a myth; architecture matters little; safety's core issue is specification-following.
kolter.zh: 到 2024 年，他认为下一个词预测能产生智能系统，是一项重大科学发现；数据短缺并非迫在眉睫，架构已不再关键，而 AI 安全当前最大的问题是模型无法可靠遵循规范。

kolter.en: Safety requires explicit training and layers, not just Scaling; bigger models are not automatically safer; jailbreaks transfer across models.
kolter.zh: 从 2024 到 2026 年，他的立场深化为：安全不能只靠 Scaling（规模扩张），需要显式训练与多层防御；更大的模型不会自动更安全，越狱字符串还能在模型间迁移。

kolter.en: AI has alien vulnerabilities; automated red teaming beats humans; capability does not correlate with robustness; the lethal trifecta drives prompt injection risk.
kolter.zh: 2026 年他进一步提出，AI 具有异于传统软件的漏洞，自动化红队已能超越人类红队；模型能力与鲁棒性不相关，而提示注入的致命三要素构成核心风险。

kolter.en: Consistent thread: empirical scaling and data/compute drive capability, while architecture and raw data curation matter less than assumed.
kolter.zh: 贯穿始终的主线是：经验性的 Scaling（规模扩张）与数据/算力驱动能力提升，而架构与原始数据整理的重要性常被高估。

fadell.en: Great products solve one pain, not everything; technology must be introduced gradually so society adapts.
fadell.zh: 2014年，他主张伟大产品只解决一个痛点，而非包揽一切；技术应逐步引入，让社会有时间适应。

fadell.en: Storytelling defines the product: write the press release before building; painkiller beats vitamin.
fadell.zh: 2019至2022年，他深化了叙事驱动产品的理念：先写新闻稿再动手，止痛药式产品胜过维生素式产品。

fadell.en: Opinion-based decisions for v1; experts can hurt innovation; beginners' mindset wins on novel problems.
fadell.zh: 2022年，他强调1.0产品靠观点而非数据决策；专家可能损害创新，新手心态在全新问题上更占优。

fadell.en: Climate urgency persists; AI needs sensor context, not just LLMs; smart home still years away.
fadell.zh: 2022至2026年，气候紧迫性一以贯之；AI需要传感器上下文而非仅靠大语言模型；智能家居仍需数年。

fadell.en: AI wearables will be a federated set, not one device; smartphone remains best single form; humans stay in the loop.
fadell.zh: 2026年，他判断AI可穿戴将是联邦式多设备组合，而非单一设备；智能手机仍是最佳单一形态；人类须保持在回路中。

ivyross.en: Design should serve unarticulated human needs; intuition is intelligence, not inferior to data.
ivyross.zh: 设计应服务于人们未言明的需求；直觉是一种智能，并不逊于数据。

ivyross.en: Technology should blend into life and amplify humanity; machines have sensors but no sensory systems.
ivyross.zh: 技术应融入生活并放大我们的人性；机器有传感器，却没有感官系统。

ivyross.en: Nature is the best designer; we are feeling creatures that think, and art is medicine.
ivyross.zh: 大自然是最好设计师；我们是先感受后思考的生物，艺术是一种良药。

ivyross.en: Constraints boost creativity; leaders should create conditions for play, inspiration, and diverse experience.
ivyross.zh: 约束能激发创造力；领导者应为玩耍、灵感与多元经验创造条件。
