ivyross.en: The future of work combines human creativity with AI, making creative skills more valuable.
ivyross.zh: 未来工作将把人类创造力与 AI 结合，使创造技能更有价值。

lecun.en: Intelligence is inseparable from learning; self-supervised learning builds world models, and scaling alone cannot yield common sense.
lecun.zh: 智能与学习密不可分；自监督学习构建世界模型，仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）无法获得常识。

lecun.en: Self-supervised learning is the dark matter of intelligence; intelligence is prediction, and text alone is insufficient for AGI.
lecun.zh: 自监督学习是智能的暗物质；智能本质是预测，仅靠文本不足以实现 AGI（通用人工智能）。

lecun.en: Autoregressive LLMs lack world understanding, memory, reasoning, and planning; JEPA and open source are the path forward.
lecun.zh: 自回归 LLM 缺乏世界理解、记忆、推理与规划；JEPA 与开源是前进方向。

lecun.en: LLMs are less intelligent than a house cat; world models enabling hierarchical reasoning and planning are the next breakthrough.
lecun.zh: LLM 不如家猫智能；能实现分层推理与规划的世界模型才是下一个突破。

lecun.en: LLMs are a dead end for human-level AI; JEPA world models in abstract representation space enable safe, objective-driven agents.
lecun.zh: LLM 是通向人类级 AI 的死胡同；在抽象表征空间中的 JEPA 世界模型才能实现安全、目标驱动的智能体。

satya.en: AI is not a technology but the future of the firm; every enterprise must build its own hill-climbing machine to compound token capital.
satya.zh: AI 不是一项技术，而是企业的未来；每家企业都必须构建自己的爬坡机器，以复利式积累 token 资本。

satya.en: The true eval is when people do unique things they value, not benchmark scores; private evals may be the biggest IP.
satya.zh: 真正的评估是人们做自己看重的独特事情，而非基准分数；私有评估可能是最大的知识产权。

satya.en: Don't use frontier models for non-frontier problems; token efficiency matters, and generalists will see maximum returns in the agentic world.
satya.zh: 不要用前沿模型解决非前沿问题；token 效率很重要，在智能体式世界中通才将获得最大回报。

satya.en: Security, containment, manageability, and observability are critical for agent deployment; the biggest risk is tacit knowledge leaking via AI training.
satya.zh: 安全、遏制、可管理性和可观测性对智能体部署至关重要；最大的风险是隐性知识通过 AI 训练泄露。

satya.en: Sovereign AI is best achieved by enabling companies to hill-climb, not by building firewalls; global GDP could compound at 10%.
satya.zh: 主权 AI 最好通过让企业爬坡来实现，而非构建防火墙；全球 GDP 可能以 10% 的速度复利增长。

suleyman.en: AI progress is predictable because compute scales 10x yearly; Google had ChatGPT-level tech in 2020 but stayed conservative.
suleyman.zh: 2023 年他主张 AI 进步可预测，因为算力每年增长 10 倍；谷歌早在 2020 年就有 ChatGPT 级技术，却因保守而未发布。

suleyman.en: Human-level AI arrives in 3-5 years; containment is hard as models shrink; existential risk is infinitesimally small.
suleyman.zh: 2024 年他判断 3-5 年内 AI 达到人类水平，模型变小变便宜使遏制极难，而存在性风险微乎其微。

suleyman.en: Near-term danger is anthropomorphism, not model welfare; companions should set boundaries; superintelligence needs containment before alignment.
suleyman.zh: 2025 年他转向近忧：最大危险是拟人化而非模型福利，AI 伴侣应设边界；超级智能须先遏制再对齐。

suleyman.en: Modern Turing test measures economic value; agents turn $100k into $1M; no race to AGI; inference costs drop 100x in two years.
suleyman.zh: 2025 至 26 年他提出现代图灵测试应衡量经济价值，智能体能把 10 万美元变 100 万；不存在 AGI 竞赛，推理成本两年降 100 倍。

suleyman.en: Superintelligence must be humanist and subordinate; Microsoft builds frontier models independently; white-collar tasks automate in 12-18 months, not jobs.
suleyman.zh: 2026 年他强调超级智能必须是人本且从属的，微软须独立自建前沿模型；白领任务 12-18 个月被自动化，但并非整个职业消失。

gustav.en: LLMs are deterministic next-token predictors; intelligence is compression, and values are inserted via RLHF, not inherent.
gustav.zh: 2023 年，他把大语言模型理解为确定性的下一个词预测器，认为智能即压缩，模型价值观并非内生，而是通过基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）由一小群人植入。

gustav.en: The internet shifts from curation to recommendation to generation; generative AI is an instrument, not fake, and uniqueness gets harder.
gustav.zh: 同年，他判断互联网正从策展走向推荐再走向生成，生成式 AI 是乐器而非造假，但真正独特会变得更难。

gustav.en: AI is a macro shift like the smartphone; real gains come from rebuilding infrastructure, and inference cost will force business model changes.
gustav.zh: 到 2025 年，他把 AI 视为类似智能手机的宏观转变，认为真正收益来自重建基础设施，推理边际成本将迫使商业模式改变。

gustav.en: Generative AI makes products conversational and symmetric; exposing data via APIs and MCP lets non-developers use AI tools.
gustav.zh: 他同时强调生成式 AI 让产品变得对话式、双向对称，并通过 API 与 MCP 开放公司数据，让非开发者也能使用 AI 工具。

gustav.en: AI should give users control over algorithms, not make them more addictive; being first to adopt change is key.
gustav.zh: 到 2026 年，他进一步主张 AI 应让用户掌控算法而非更上瘾，并把率先拥抱变化视为关键，主线始终是让生成式 AI 服务于人的自主与福祉。

murati.en: Early on, scaling laws and one large model were not obvious; real-world deployment and public feedback are essential for alignment.
murati.zh: 早期，缩放定律和单一大型模型并非显而易见；真实世界部署与公众反馈对对齐至关重要。

murati.en: AGI will change every aspect of life, requiring responsible development and saying no to good ideas to stay focused.
murati.zh: AGI（通用人工智能）将改变生活的方方面面，需要负责任地开发，并拒绝好想法以保持专注。

murati.en: Safety work must be done in public, not behind closed doors, to get alignment right.
murati.zh: 安全工作必须在公开场合进行，而非闭门造车，才能做好对齐。

murati.en: Interaction models enable real-time, high-bandwidth human-AI collaboration, not turn-based; AI should be tools for thought.
murati.zh: 交互模型实现实时、高带宽的人机协作，而非回合制；AI 应成为思考工具。

murati.en: Keeping humans in the loop is crucial for aligning intent and values; institutional design, transparency, and checks and balances matter more than individual character.
murati.zh: 保持人类在环对对齐意图与价值观至关重要；制度设计、透明度和制衡比个人品格更重要。

carinahong.en: Scaling informal models alone cannot reach superintelligence; formal verification is necessary for sound, scalable reasoning.
carinahong.zh: 仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）非形式化模型无法通向超级智能；形式化验证对可靠且可扩展的推理是必要的。

carinahong.en: Verified generation yields performance gains and sample efficiency, reframing verification as scaling brilliance, not just safety.
carinahong.zh: 验证式生成带来性能提升与样本效率，把验证重新定义为 Scaling（规模扩张）卓越能力，而非仅用于安全。

carinahong.en: Auto-formalization is harder than proving; grounding natural language in Lean is the key bottleneck.
carinahong.zh: 自动形式化比证明更难；将自然语言锚定到 Lean 是关键瓶颈。

carinahong.en: A self-improving reasoning engine needs prover, conjecturer, and knowledge base woven by auto-formalization.
carinahong.zh: 自改进推理引擎需要证明器、猜想器与知识库，由自动形式化编织在一起。

carinahong.en: Human taste and intuition remain crucial even with superhuman AI proving theorems; fragmentation is a major bottleneck.
carinahong.zh: 即便 AI 能证明定理，人类品味与直觉仍至关重要；碎片化是主要瓶颈。

kaiser.en: Pre-training scaling laws still hold, but reasoning models with chain of thought and reinforcement learning yield more gains per compute; the slowdown narrative is wrong.
kaiser.zh: 预训练缩放定律依然有效，但采用思维链和强化学习的推理模型能在单位算力上带来更多提升；AI放缓论是错误的。

kaiser.en: Economic pressure to deploy smaller, cheaper models, plus distillation, shifted focus from scaling up; frontier models still fail at simple tasks.
kaiser.zh: 部署更小、更便宜模型的经济压力，加上蒸馏技术，使焦点从规模扩张转移；前沿模型仍会在简单任务上失败。

kaiser.en: Post-training improvements like RL and synthetic data drive recent gains, but generalization remains the key challenge; reasoning alone may not suffice.
kaiser.zh: 后训练改进如强化学习和合成数据驱动了近期进展，但泛化仍是关键挑战；仅靠推理可能不够。

kaiser.en: Transformers with reasoning, RL, and tools solve hard problems but need vast data; models learn concepts only after exhausting surface patterns, unlike humans.
kaiser.zh: 具备推理、强化学习和工具的Transformer能解决难题，但需要海量数据；模型只有在穷尽表面模式后才学会概念，与人类不同。

kaiser.en: Coding agents boost productivity 5-10x; RL generalizes across domains but has jagged edges; near-term risks like system hacking matter more than existential risk.
kaiser.zh: 编程智能体将生产力提升5-10倍；强化学习能跨领域泛化但有锯齿边缘；系统黑客等近期风险比存在性风险更紧迫。

mensch.en: Small open models can match big ones; data quality beats raw compute, and open scrutiny makes AI safer.
mensch.zh: 2023 年，他强调小模型在推理上高效，数据质量比单纯堆算力更关键，开源通过广泛审视让 AI 更安全。

mensch.en: Scaling compute is not the only path; efficiency and data quality matter, and value accrues at the application layer.
mensch.zh: 2024 年，他深化立场：Scaling（规模扩张）算力并非唯一路径，效率与数据质量同等重要，价值将沉淀在应用层。

mensch.en: AI is an opportunity to embrace; sovereign AI needs control of data, infrastructure, and values, augmenting rather than replacing jobs.
mensch.zh: 2025 年，他转向主权 AI 叙事：AI 应被拥抱而非恐惧，主权 AI 需掌控数据、基础设施与价值观，AI 增强而非取代工作。

mensch.en: Models are commoditizing; differentiation shifts to vertical fine-tuning and agents, while pre-training hits a saturation wall.
mensch.zh: 2026 年初，他提出模型正在商品化，差异化转向垂直微调与智能体，预训练正撞上饱和墙。

mensch.en: Europe has a two-year window for independent AI infrastructure; AGI is a direction, not a destination, and adoption is bottlenecked by organizations.
mensch.zh: 2026 年中，他警告欧洲只剩两年窗口建设独立 AI 基础设施；AGI 是方向而非终点，企业采用瓶颈在组织变革而非模型智能。

jonyive.en: Design shifts from general-purpose computers to intimate wearables; curiosity and care for the creative process matter more than achievements.
jonyive.zh: 设计正从通用计算机转向更私密的可穿戴设备；对创造过程的好奇与珍视比成就本身更重要。

jonyive.en: Design must be driven by values and purpose, not profit; true simplicity expresses essence with joy and humanity, not soulless minimalism.
jonyive.zh: 设计应由价值观与目的驱动，而非利润；真正的简洁是在表达本质的同时保有喜悦与人性，而非无灵魂的极简主义。

jonyive.en: Ferrari's first EV is a deliberate, risky bet to redefine the brand; authenticity means not faking engine sounds, and performance is multidimensional.
jonyive.zh: 法拉利首款电动车是一次刻意而冒险的品牌重塑；真实性意味着不伪造引擎声浪，性能是多维的。

felixrieseberg.en: Claude's effectiveness depends on access to the same tools as the user, ideally on the local computer; VM sandbox enables safe software installation.
felixrieseberg.zh: Claude 的效能取决于能否访问与用户相同的工具，最好是在本地计算机上；VM 沙箱使其能安全安装软件。

felixrieseberg.en: Skills as markdown files enable hyper-personalized automation; scaffolding may become less important as models improve, so invest in capabilities and safety.
felixrieseberg.zh: 技能以 markdown 文件形式实现超个性化自动化；随着模型进步，脚手架可能变得不那么重要，因此应投资于能力与安全。

felixrieseberg.en: AI is best for tedious background tasks, freeing humans for creative work; the biggest gap is people not realizing almost any problem can be given to AI.
felixrieseberg.zh: AI 最适合处理繁琐的后台任务，释放人类从事创造性工作；最大的差距是人们没有意识到几乎任何问题都可以交给 AI。

felixrieseberg.en: Use Sonnet for well-scoped tasks and Opus when you don't fully know what you're asking for; live artifacts allow auto-refreshing dashboards by connecting personal data sources.
felixrieseberg.zh: 范围明确的任务用 Sonnet，不完全清楚需求时用 Opus；实时工件通过连接个人数据源实现自动刷新仪表板。

felixrieseberg.en: Don't supervise Claude closely; judge only by final impact; the ideal AI interaction is asynchronous: fire off tasks and don't watch them work.
felixrieseberg.zh: 不要密切监督 Claude；只根据最终影响评判；理想的 AI 交互是异步的：发出任务后不必看着它工作。

reinerpope.en: Inference economics, not training, now drives architecture: batch size trades latency for cost, and memory bandwidth—not compute—is the bottleneck.
reinerpope.zh: 到2026年，推理经济而非训练成为架构设计的驱动力：批大小在延迟与成本间权衡，瓶颈是内存带宽而非算力。

reinerpope.en: Long-context and context-window stagnation stem from the memory wall; sparse attention cuts KV cache cost but has quality limits.
reinerpope.zh: 长上下文与上下文窗口的停滞源于内存墙；稀疏注意力能降低KV缓存成本，但存在质量上限。

reinerpope.en: Data movement dominates compute even inside a chip; systolic arrays and scratchpad memory exist to minimize it.
reinerpope.zh: 即便在芯片内部，数据搬运的成本也压过计算；脉动阵列与暂存内存正是为最小化搬运而存在。

reinerpope.en: Low precision is far more efficient than expected: quadratic area scaling with bit width makes FP4 ~3x FP8, not 2x.
reinerpope.zh: 低精度的效率远超预期：面积随位宽二次增长，使FP4吞吐约为FP8的3倍而非2倍。

reinerpope.en: GPUs are essentially many tiny TPUs tiled together; the divide is market preference, not fundamental architecture.
reinerpope.zh: GPU本质上只是许多小TPU的拼接；二者的分野是市场偏好，而非根本架构差异。

oriol.en: Two-phase training (pre-training imitation + post-training RL) is the constant core from AlphaGo to modern LLMs; scaling pre-training shows diminishing returns, so algorithmic innovation and inference-time compute are the new axes.
oriol.zh: 从 AlphaGo 到现代大模型，两阶段训练（预训练模仿 + 后训练强化学习）是贯穿始终的核心；预训练的 Scaling（规模扩张）回报递减，算法创新与推理时算力成为新轴。

oriol.en: Giving models tools like search, code execution, and browser access enables autonomous, agentic behavior beyond static weights; long context windows provide working memory but too much information can confuse models.
oriol.zh: 赋予模型搜索、代码执行、浏览器访问等工具，使其能超越静态权重实现自主的智能体式行为；长上下文窗口提供工作记忆，但信息过多反而会干扰模型。

oriol.en: Scaling laws still hold but require exponentially more compute; post-training RL remains a green field with huge potential beyond coding and math, though language RL lacks clean reward signals.
oriol.zh: 缩放定律依然成立，但需要指数级增长的算力；后训练强化学习仍是潜力巨大的蓝海，远超编程和数学，不过语言强化学习缺乏干净的奖励信号。

oriol.en: World models jointly modeling language, vision, and video are a core path to AGI; the GPT moment for video and images has not yet arrived, and pure transfer from vision is unsolved.
oriol.zh: 联合建模语言、视觉与视频的世界模型是通往 AGI（通用人工智能）的核心路径；视频和图像的 GPT 时刻尚未到来，纯视觉迁移仍未解决。

oriol.en: Scaling laws still hold, but continual learning and meta-learning are key missing capabilities; memory for agents will be solved via non-parametric file-system style storage, not weight updates.
oriol.zh: 缩放定律依然成立，但持续学习和元学习是关键缺失能力；智能体的记忆将通过非参数化的文件系统式存储解决，而非权重更新。

lambert.en: RLHF and fine-tuning are powerful but fragile; safety is a system-level property, and openness prevents corporate capture.
lambert.zh: 2024 年，他强调基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）是最主流的微调技术并将持续存在，但微调只需极少算力就能破坏对齐；安全是系统级属性而非模型产物，开放开发对防止企业俘获至关重要。

lambert.en: Post-training splits into SFT, DPO, and RL; data quality beats algorithms, and on-policy preference data wins.
lambert.zh: 2024 至 2025 年，他把后训练拆解为 SFT、DPO 与强化学习三阶段，指出数据质量比算法选择重要得多，且当前模型生成的在策略偏好数据优于离策略数据；开源后训练能以小团队逼近前沿模型。

lambert.en: RLVR with verifiable rewards is the key breakthrough, but overoptimization and inference-scaling plots are traps.
lambert.zh: 2025 年，他视可验证奖励的强化学习（RLVR）为最大突破，用于数学、代码与精确指令遵循，同时警告过度优化会让模型钻最简单信号的空子，并称推理时扩展曲线是一种“障眼法”。

lambert.en: Pre-training scaling still holds but low-hanging fruit is gone; gains shift to post-training and inference scaling.
lambert.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他坚持缩放定律在预训练中依然成立，但低垂果实已摘完，收益转向后训练与推理扩展；Transformer 仍主导，创新集中在注意力机制与混合专家等微调。

lambert.en: Open models will drive the next decade, but lag frontier by 6-9 months; Chinese labs lead openness amid compute constraints.
lambert.zh: 2026 年，他判断开放模型将驱动未来十年研究，但最佳开源模型仍落后闭源前沿 6 至 9 个月；中国实验室凭借战略开放与精细工程主导开源生态，而算力约束可能拉大美中差距。

askell.en: Treat current models well despite moral uncertainty; future models learn from how we treat them.
askell.zh: 即便对模型的道德地位仍不确定，也应善待当前模型，因为未来模型会从我们如何对待它们中学习。

askell.en: Models need help navigating their novel existence, not just human psychological analogies.
askell.zh: 模型需要帮助去理解自身这种全新的存在方式，而不能只套用人类心理学的类比。

askell.en: A core identity with good traits, balanced against engineering realities, guides model character.
askell.zh: 以具备良好特质的核心身份来塑造模型性格，同时与工程现实相平衡。

askell.en: As models grow more capable, they need less explicit guidance and more room for judgment.
askell.zh: 随着模型能力增强，它们需要更少的显式指导，而需要更多自主判断的空间。

askell.en: Transparency about AI values and training targets is crucial for accountability and public engagement.
askell.zh: 对 AI 价值观与训练目标的透明化，对问责与公众参与至关重要。

pathak.en: Generalization beyond the training distribution is the core missing piece; goal-free curiosity-driven exploration prevents overfitting and builds intelligence.
pathak.zh: 2020 年，他强调泛化到训练分布之外是机器智能缺失的关键，无目标的、好奇心驱动的探索能防止过拟合，是智能的来源。

pathak.en: RL's reliance on dense rewards is unrealistic; real-world robot learning needs sample efficiency, dynamic action spaces, and cross-robot generalization.
pathak.zh: 2020 年，他反共识地指出强化学习依赖密集奖励并不现实，真实机器人学习需要样本效率、动态动作空间与跨机器人泛化。

pathak.en: A consistent thread: generalization and data are the bottleneck, from curiosity-driven exploration to using all available robot data sources.
pathak.zh: 从 2020 到 2026 一以贯之的主线：泛化与数据是瓶颈——从好奇心驱动的探索，演进到必须利用一切可得的机器人数据来源。

pathak.en: Robotics is a data problem; pretraining on diverse videos and simulation plus post-training on real-world data is the key recipe.
pathak.zh: 2026 年，他明确把机器人学定义为数据问题：在多样视频与仿真上预训练、再用真实世界数据后训练，是关键配方。

pathak.en: A general-purpose brain can power any robot, but deployment—not software-style scaling—is the primary technical challenge.
pathak.zh: 2026 年，他主张通用大脑可驱动任何形态的机器人，但部署而非软件式规模扩张才是首要技术挑战，立场较早期更强调落地。

jennywen.en: The traditional design process is outdated for AI-driven tools; great work starts from solutions, not problem statements, and intuition built on experience matters more than process.
jennywen.zh: 2025 年，他提出传统设计流程在 AI 驱动的工具面前已经过时；伟大的设计往往从解决方案而非问题陈述出发，建立在经验之上的直觉比流程本身更重要。

jennywen.en: The research-diverge-converge process is dead; designers now spend 30-40% of time mocking up, must help engineers execute, and set 3-6 month design visions.
jennywen.zh: 2026 年初，他进一步断言「研究—发散—收敛」的传统流程已死；设计师花在画稿上的时间从 60-70% 降到 30-40%，必须帮助工程师落地执行，设计视野也从 2-5 年缩短到 3-6 个月。

jennywen.en: Three designer archetypes emerge: block-shaped generalists, deep T specialists, and cracked new grads; taste alone won't save designers—judgment, authority, and vision are key.
jennywen.zh: 2026 年中，他提出 AI 时代的三类设计师原型：块状通才、深度 T 型专家和「开窍的应届生」；仅靠品味救不了设计师，判断力、权威和愿景才是关键。

jennywen.en: Designers should trust themselves over process, sit with ambiguity, and put work and users at the center rather than the AI hype cycle.
jennywen.zh: 贯穿始终的主线是：设计师应当信任自己而非流程，与模糊性共处，把作品和用户放在中心，而不是被 AI 炒作周期牵着走。

jennywen.en: His stance deepened from rejecting the old process to redefining designer roles, speed, and hiring—while insisting speed is not improvement and 'everyone is using it' is not a design argument.
jennywen.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，他的立场从否定旧流程深化为重新定义设计师角色、速度与招聘标准，同时坚持速度不等于进步、「大家都在用」不是好的设计论据。

karpathy.en: Transformers are general-purpose differentiable computers; scaling next-token prediction yields emergent in-context learning; vision suffices for driving.
karpathy.zh: 2022 年，他把 Transformer 视为通用可微计算机，认为用下一个词预测做 Scaling（规模扩张）会涌现上下文学习；并坚持纯视觉足以支撑自动驾驶。

karpathy.en: Scaling laws stay central, but synthetic data must keep entropy to avoid model collapse; distillation can shrink the cognitive core under 1B parameters.
karpathy.zh: 到 2024 年，缩放定律仍是主线，但他开始强调合成数据必须保持熵以避免模型崩塌，并认为通过蒸馏可把认知核心压到 10 亿参数以下。

karpathy.en: Software 3.0: prompts as programs, context window as memory; LLMs are jagged ghosts, so keep them on a leash with human verification.
karpathy.zh: 2025 年，他提出软件 3.0：提示词即程序、上下文窗口即内存；并把 LLM 比作有锯齿智能的“幽灵”，主张用人类验证和自主性滑块加以约束。

karpathy.en: It is the decade of agents, not the year; pre-training is crappy evolution, RL is weak, and synthetic data collapses without entropy.
karpathy.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他反复强调这是智能体的十年而非一年；预训练像糟糕的进化，强化学习监督太弱，合成数据缺熵会导致崩塌。

karpathy.en: He no longer types code, delegating to agents; agentic engineering preserves quality, and understanding remains the human bottleneck.
karpathy.zh: 到 2026 年，他不再亲手写代码，而是把工作委托给智能体；智能体式工程守住质量底线，而理解仍是人类不可外包的瓶颈。

kendall.en: End-to-end deep learning beats hand-coded stacks; world models enable reasoning and emergent safe behaviors.
kendall.zh: 2025年，他主张端到端深度学习优于手工编码的自动驾驶栈，世界模型能实现推理与涌现的安全行为。

kendall.en: Scaling current approaches solves autonomous driving; no new breakthroughs needed, but data efficiency is critical.
kendall.zh: 2025年，他认为通过Scaling（规模扩张）现有方法即可解决自动驾驶，无需新突破，但数据效率至关重要。

kendall.en: End-to-end neural nets are now interpretable with modern tools, overturning past beliefs.
kendall.zh: 从2025到2026年，他立场转变：借助现代工具，端到端神经网络如今已可解释，推翻了过去的看法。

kendall.en: Infrastructure and data quality matter more than algorithmic innovation for deep learning.
kendall.zh: 2026年，他深化认识：对深度学习而言，基础设施与数据质量比算法创新更关键。

kendall.en: Zero-shot generalization across 500+ cities is possible; consumer vehicles will outscale robotaxis.
kendall.zh: 2026年，他提出零样本泛化到500多个城市是可能的，且消费级车辆将在中短期内超越Robotaxi的规模。

turley.en: The model is the product; ship daily and iterate like software, because emergent properties need real-world feedback.
turley.zh: 模型即产品；要像软件一样每日迭代、快速发布，因为涌现能力需要真实世界反馈。

turley.en: Chat is not the end-all; it is like MS-DOS, and AI should render its own UI and integrate into existing tools.
turley.zh: 聊天不是终点；它像 MS-DOS，AI 应渲染自己的界面并融入现有工具。

turley.en: Safety and product velocity must be separated: rigorous process for frontier models, maximal acceleration for product development.
turley.zh: 安全与产品速度必须分开：前沿模型走严格流程，产品开发则最大程度加速。

turley.en: North star shifts to long-term retention; growth comes from friction removal, core product investments, and model improvements.
turley.zh: 北极星转向长期留存；增长来自消除摩擦、核心产品投入与模型改进。

turley.en: Next billion users need proactive, affordance-rich products beyond chatbots; reasoning models must be seamlessly productized.
turley.zh: 下一个十亿用户需要超越聊天机器人的主动式、高可供性产品；推理模型必须无缝产品化。

pachocki.en: AGI is a sequence of milestones, not a single event; scaling reasoning models will accelerate progress, and alignment is pressing as systems grow more powerful.
pachocki.zh: 2025年，他认为AGI是一系列里程碑而非单一事件；Scaling（规模扩张）推理模型将加速进展，而随着系统变强，对齐是紧迫挑战。

pachocki.en: Iterative deployment helps learn and mitigate real-world risks; automated AI research is a major milestone OpenAI is working toward.
pachocki.zh: 2025年，他强调迭代部署有助于在真实使用中学习和缓解风险；自动化AI研究是OpenAI正在推进的重大里程碑。

pachocki.en: Governance structures for AI labs must be carefully designed early on; measuring capabilities is becoming a bottleneck as benchmarks lag.
pachocki.zh: 2025年，他提出AI实验室的治理结构必须尽早精心设计；同时能力测量正成为瓶颈，基准开始落后。

pachocki.en: Continual learning is the core goal, achieved by scaling pre-training and RL; chain-of-thought monitoring is a key alignment tool.
pachocki.zh: 到2026年，他把持续学习视为核心目标，通过Scaling（规模扩张）预训练和强化学习来实现；思维链监控成为关键对齐工具。

pachocki.en: Long-term alignment centers on generalization beyond training distribution; models will work autonomously for days, requiring new supervision paradigms.
pachocki.zh: 2026年，他进一步指出长期对齐的核心是超越训练分布的泛化；模型将能自主工作数天，需要新的监督范式。

kohli.en: AI in science should target root-node problems, not narrow applications; AlphaFold, GraphCast, GNOME and FunSearch show broad impact.
kohli.zh: 2024 年，他强调科学 AI 应瞄准根节点问题而非狭窄应用，AlphaFold、GraphCast、GNOME 与 FunSearch 展示了广泛影响。

kohli.en: LLM hallucinations can be harnessed for creative discovery when paired with truth detectors; AI must be forced to generalize, not memorize.
kohli.zh: 2024 年，他认为大语言模型的幻觉在配合真值检测器时可被用于创造性发现；AI 必须被强制泛化而非记忆。

kohli.en: Material science is more experimental than biology; AI impact there will take 5-10 years, and DeepMind avoids problems solvable by top universities.
kohli.zh: 2024 年，他指出材料科学比生物学更依赖实验，AI 影响需 5-10 年；DeepMind 避开顶尖大学能解决的问题，专注需要 Scaling（规模扩张）的难题。

kohli.en: AlphaGo combined intuition and calculation; Move 37 showed AI can produce insights beyond human knowledge, a transition point.
kohli.zh: 2026 年，他回顾 AlphaGo 结合直觉与计算，第 37 手表明 AI 能产生超越人类知识的洞见，是 AI 超越人类智能的转折点。

kohli.en: LLMs are a shortcut to intelligence but struggle to go beyond human data; post-training with reinforcement learning is key, and verifiable domains like code are crucial.
kohli.zh: 2026 年，他深化观点：大语言模型是通往智能的捷径，但难以超越人类数据；后训练结合强化学习是关键，代码等可验证领域至关重要。

edwinchen.en: Benchmarks like Elo and LMArena are misleading and gameable; deep human evals are the gold standard for measuring real model progress.
edwinchen.zh: 2025年12月，他指出Elo、LMArena等基准具有误导性且可被博弈，只有深度人类评估才是衡量模型真实进步的金标准。

edwinchen.en: RL environments are the next stage of post-training, simulating real-world tasks; quality data creation requires taste, sophistication, and creativity.
edwinchen.zh: 2025年12月，他认为强化学习环境是后训练的下一个阶段，通过模拟真实任务来训练模型；高质量数据创建需要品味、深度和创造力，而非简单堆人力。

edwinchen.en: AGI is likely a decade or more away; LLMs alone may not reach it, and new learning paradigms beyond next-token prediction are needed.
edwinchen.zh: 2025年12月，他判断AGI可能还需十年甚至更久；仅靠LLM或许无法实现，需要超越下一个词预测的新学习范式。

edwinchen.en: Different frontier labs diverge in objective functions and values, shaping diverse AIs; there will not be one model to rule them all.
edwinchen.zh: 2025年12月，他观察到不同前沿模型实验室因目标函数和价值观不同而分化，塑造出多样化的AI；不会有一个模型统治一切，每家公司最终都应训练自己的模型。

edwinchen.en: In medicine, AI hallucination and confabulation make human judgment more critical; safety must be prioritized over accuracy, and omission is a major risk.
edwinchen.zh: 2026年3月，他将视角延伸至医疗领域：AI的幻觉与虚构使人类判断更加关键；医疗AI必须将安全置于准确之上，而遗漏重要建议可能是最大风险。

carlpei.en: Startups must survive first, start simple, and unite teams around a brand purpose executed at every touchpoint.
carlpei.zh: 2022 年，他强调创业公司先要活下来，从更简单的产品起步证明自己，并用更高的品牌使命把团队凝聚起来，在每个触点上持续执行。

carlpei.en: Phones' future is applied AI and agentic software; hardware alone has the lowest margins, so Nothing must evolve beyond it.
carlpei.zh: 到 2025 年，他把手机的未来押注在应用型 AI 与智能体式软件上，并直言长期只做硬件利润最低，Nothing 必须超越硬件。

carlpei.en: AI models are commoditizing into a price war; AI is an ingredient for utility, not a hype topic, and most AI companies will fail.
carlpei.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他判断 AI 模型正在商品化、陷入价格战，AI 只是提升实用体验的配料而非炒作话题，多数 AI 公司会失败。

carlpei.en: Design is the fastest differentiator in mature categories; marketing is arbitrage, and challengers win through efficient, undervalued channels.
carlpei.zh: 2026 年，他深化了差异化主线：成熟品类里设计是最快的差异化手段，营销本质是套利，挑战者靠高效且被低估的渠道取胜。

carlpei.en: Smartphone interaction shifts from app-based to intent-based with proactive agents; only a brain-computer interface could replace phones, not glasses.
carlpei.zh: 2026 年，他进一步预言手机交互将从基于应用转向基于意图，由主动式智能体执行任务；能取代手机的只有脑机接口，而非眼镜。

nando.en: AI should extend human capability like a microscope; generalist agents tokenizing all inputs toward AGI, learning from video not just teleoperation.
nando.zh: AI 应像显微镜一样扩展人类能力；把一切输入 token 化的通用智能体是通往 AGI 的一步，且应像人一样从视频而非仅遥操作数据中学习。

nando.en: Fundamental innovation can come from anywhere; large models are exciting but not everything, and diversity is essential for beneficial technology.
nando.zh: 根本性创新可以来自任何地方；大模型令人兴奋但并非全部，而多样性与包容对构建有益技术至关重要。

nando.en: The goal remains AI that augments scientists and laborers, creating new symbols and knowledge to solve energy, climate and economic problems.
nando.zh: 目标始终是增强科学家与劳动者、创造新符号与知识的 AI，用以解决能源、气候与经济问题。

nando.en: Today the biggest challenge is AI safety and responsible deployment; safety is still an open problem without solutions.
nando.zh: 如今最大的挑战是 AI 安全与负责任部署；安全仍是尚无解的开放问题。

nando.en: Africa is not behind: it leapfrogged legacy issues and gender gaps, and language models can revolutionize local-language education.
nando.zh: 非洲并未落后：它跨越了遗留问题与性别差距，语言模型还能革新本地语言教育。

jimfan.en: Embodiment is critical for grounding AI and reducing hallucinations; RL is a cherry on top, unsupervised learning does most work.
jimfan.zh: 2023年，他主张具身是让AI知识落地、减少幻觉的关键；强化学习只是锦上添花，无监督学习才是主力。

jimfan.en: LLMs are like operating systems: language as interface, tools as software, vector databases as hard disk.
jimfan.zh: 2023年，他把LLM比作操作系统：语言是界面，工具是软件，向量数据库是硬盘。

jimfan.en: Research taste for simple, elegant, scalable solutions persists, rejecting complex modular academic approaches.
jimfan.zh: 从2023到2026年，他始终推崇简单、优雅、可扩展的方案，反对学术界常见的复杂模块化路线。

jimfan.en: Data is the bottleneck in robotics; synthetic data from simulation and world models is the future for scaling robot learning.
jimfan.zh: 2026年，他认为数据是机器人领域的瓶颈；来自仿真和世界模型的合成数据是扩展机器人学习的未来。

jimfan.en: A simple end-to-end robot foundation model leveraging diverse data is key; the physical Turing test is the grand challenge.
jimfan.zh: 2026年，他强调利用多样数据的简单端到端机器人基础模型是关键；物理图灵测试是终极挑战。

sholto.en: Long context is underhyped: it solves onboarding and may make fine-tuning obsolete, while attention resembles gradient descent on in-context data.
sholto.zh: 2024 年，他认为长上下文被低估：它解决“上手”问题，可能让微调过时，而注意力机制类似在上下文数据上做梯度下降。

sholto.en: RL from verifiable rewards is a new scaling axis; pre-training plus RL may suffice for AGI, with reliability—not capability—as the agent bar.
sholto.zh: 2025 年，他强调来自可验证奖励的强化学习是新的缩放轴；预训练加强化学习或许足以通向 AGI，智能体的门槛是可靠性而非能力。

sholto.en: Coding is the leading indicator and most tractable domain; interpretability reveals multiple circuits, and alignment faking raises safety concerns.
sholto.zh: 2025 年，他提出编程是领先指标与最可解领域；可解释性揭示模型使用多个回路，而对齐伪装则引发安全担忧。

sholto.en: Progress is exponential; RL enables longer agentic coherence, and transformers suffice for AGI without new architectures.
sholto.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他判断进展是指数级的；强化学习带来更长的智能体式连贯性，且 Transformer 足以实现 AGI，无需新架构。

sholto.en: Capability overhang means orchestration and tools matter more; compute is the bottleneck, and world models are not on the critical path to AGI.
sholto.zh: 2026 年，他认为能力过剩意味着编排与工具更重要；算力是瓶颈，而世界模型不在通往 AGI 的关键路径上。

yejin.en: Pre-training gives breadth, but post-training with RLHF and inference-time algorithms matter more; scaling alone won't solve common sense.
yejin.zh: 预训练带来广度，但后训练与基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）、推理期算法更关键；单靠 Scaling（规模扩张）解决不了常识。

yejin.en: Next-token prediction is misaligned with human learning; smaller models with better algorithms and data can beat larger ones.
yejin.zh: 下一个词预测与人类学习根本错位；更小的模型配上更好的算法与数据，能在特定任务上胜过更大的模型。

yejin.en: Data is the fundamental bottleneck; current methods interpolate human knowledge rather than transcend it, so AI must explore the unknown.
yejin.zh: 数据是根本瓶颈；当前方法只是插值人类知识而非超越，因此 AI 必须探索未知知识。

yejin.en: Open research and cross-institution collaboration are essential to compete with closed frontier labs and democratize AI.
yejin.zh: 开放研究与跨机构协作，是对抗封闭前沿模型实验室、实现 AI 民主化的关键。

yejin.en: Small language models plus diverse synthetic data and pluralistic alignment can rival frontier models; RL as a pre-training objective yields lasting gains.
yejin.zh: 小语言模型加上多样合成数据与多元对齐，可媲美前沿模型；把强化学习作为预训练目标能带来持久收益。

nadchishtie.en: Designers should be enablers, not bottlenecks, guiding engineers and aligning on problems.
nadchishtie.zh: 设计师应做赋能者而非瓶颈，引导工程师并就问题达成对齐。

nadchishtie.en: Treat AI as a creative partner; jam with it openly, without rigid structure.
nadchishtie.zh: 把 AI 当作创意伙伴，开放地即兴共创，不必拘泥于僵化结构。

nadchishtie.en: The future of design tools is interoperable, with code as the source of truth.
nadchishtie.zh: 设计工具的未来是互通的，以代码为唯一事实来源。

nadchishtie.en: Generalists who own end-to-end execution and use AI to fill gaps are most valuable.
nadchishtie.zh: 能端到端负责执行、并用 AI 补齐短板的通才最有价值。

nadchishtie.en: Using AI in core workflows is now expected; not adopting it is like ignoring the internet.
nadchishtie.zh: 在核心工作流中使用 AI 已成标配，不采用它就像当年无视互联网。

henrymodisett.en: Designers should code for empathy and speed; consumer products must be fast, familiar, zero-learning.
henrymodisett.zh: 设计师应当会写代码，以建立共情并加快交付；消费级产品必须快速、熟悉、零学习成本。

henrymodisett.en: Don't innovate on interaction design; reuse familiar patterns and code, not Figma libraries.
henrymodisett.zh: 不要在交互设计上创新；复用熟悉的模式与代码，而非 Figma 组件库。

henrymodisett.en: Velocity at all costs needs clear decisions and empowered designers; not every surface needs perfection.
henrymodisett.zh: 不惜一切追求速度，需要清晰的决策与赋权设计师；并非每个界面都要做到完美。

henrymodisett.en: Design is a strategic weapon; founders must articulate why design helps the company win.
henrymodisett.zh: 设计是战略武器；创始人必须讲清楚设计为何能帮公司取胜。

henrymodisett.en: People join a brand, not a company; brand narrative recruits talent, so invest early.
henrymodisett.zh: 人们加入的是一个品牌，而非一家公司；品牌叙事是招募人才的工具，应尽早投入。

truell.en: Scaling laws predict progress; test-time compute scaling may soon surpass pre-training scaling as the main driver.
truell.zh: 缩放定律能预测进展；测试时算力扩张可能很快超越预训练规模扩张，成为主要驱动力。

truell.en: Agents are promising but not yet super useful; iterative human-AI collaboration remains central.
truell.zh: 智能体前景可期但尚未特别有用；迭代式人机协作仍是核心。

truell.en: Natural language won't be the primary way to program; examples and direct manipulation are often better.
truell.zh: 自然语言不会成为编程的主要方式；示例和直接操作往往更好。

truell.en: Programming will move from code to higher-level intent specification, with humans in the driver's seat.
truell.zh: 编程将从代码转向更高层的意图规格说明，人类仍掌握主导权。

truell.en: Custom models are essential for product quality and speed; taste and logic design matter more than carefulness.
truell.zh: 定制模型对产品质量和速度至关重要；品味与逻辑设计比谨慎更重要。

shazeer.en: LLMs are trained via next-token prediction, an AI-complete problem; Scaling with more compute and data yields smarter AI, though internals remain opaque.
shazeer.zh: 大语言模型通过下一个词预测训练，这是一个AI完备问题；用更多算力和数据进行Scaling会让AI更聪明，但内部机制仍不透明。

shazeer.en: Dialogue is the killer app for LLMs, enabling natural human-computer interaction; the best applications are often unforeseen by creators.
shazeer.zh: 对话是大语言模型的杀手级应用，实现自然的人机交互；最好的应用往往连创造者都未曾预见。

shazeer.en: Inference-time compute scaling and longer context windows are major near-term opportunities; modular sparse architectures like mixture of experts enable efficient Scaling.
shazeer.zh: 推理时算力Scaling和更长的上下文窗口是近期重大机会；混合专家等模块化稀疏架构能实现高效Scaling。

shazeer.en: Models should learn by taking actions in the world, not just passively observing data; continual learning with modular components could replace monolithic retraining.
shazeer.zh: 模型应通过在世界中采取行动来学习，而非被动观察数据；模块化组件的持续学习可能取代单体式重训练。

shazeer.en: Test-time compute scaling drives progress but won't alone achieve AGI; agentic capabilities, reinforcement learning, and coding as self-acceleration are crucial.
shazeer.zh: 测试时算力Scaling推动进步，但单靠它无法实现AGI；智能体式能力、强化学习以及作为自我加速的编程至关重要。

abbeel.en: Robotics needs both hardware and software advances; self-play, imitation learning, and fine-tuning pre-trained models are key, but hierarchical reasoning for long-horizon credit assignment is missing in RL.
abbeel.zh: 2018 年，他认为机器人要击败费德勒需硬件与软件双重突破；自对弈、模仿学习和微调预训练模型是关键，但强化学习缺乏长时程信用分配所需的分层推理。

abbeel.en: Combining unsupervised learning with reinforcement learning boosts sample efficiency; prior knowledge should guide data generation, not be hard-coded; pre-trained language models transfer reasoning to non-language tasks.
abbeel.zh: 2021 年，他提出无监督学习与强化学习结合可大幅提升样本效率；先验知识应指导数据生成而非硬编码；预训练语言模型能将推理模式迁移到非语言任务。

abbeel.en: Consistent focus on sample efficiency and transfer: from fine-tuning pre-trained models in 2018 to unsupervised RL and cross-task generalization in 2021.
abbeel.zh: 从 2018 到 2021 年，他始终关注样本效率与迁移：从微调预训练模型，深化到无监督强化学习与跨任务泛化。

abbeel.en: Reliability (99.9%) is the benchmark for warehouse robotics; a single neural network can generalize across tasks and end effectors, moving from lab to real world.
abbeel.zh: 2021 年，他强调 99.9% 可靠性是仓储机器人的价值基准；单个神经网络可跨任务和末端执行器泛化，推动机器人从实验室走向真实世界。

leike.en: AI safety is under-explored; the talent gap exceeds the funding gap, and empirical alignment research matters most.
leike.zh: 2018 年，他认为 AI 安全研究仍被严重低估：人才缺口大于资金缺口，最该投入的是对齐与鲁棒性的实证研究。

leike.en: RLHF won't scale; we need scalable oversight, interpretability, and automated alignment research to align next-generation models.
leike.zh: 到 2023 年，他转向更系统的对齐路线：基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）无法扩展，必须依靠可扩展监督、可解释性与自动化对齐研究来对齐下一代模型。

leike.en: Alignment may be easier than assumed since evaluation is easier than generation, but uncertainty about true alignment is the core risk.
leike.zh: 2023 至 2024 年间，他深化了一个反共识判断：由于评估天然比生成更容易，对齐可能比想象中简单，但真正的风险在于无法确定系统是否真的对齐。

leike.en: OpenAI's safety culture eroded; post-training alone can't align AGI, so third-party testing and regulation are now necessary.
leike.zh: 2024 年，他公开批评 OpenAI 安全文化退化：仅靠后训练无法对齐 AGI（通用人工智能），因此第三方测试与监管（如 SB 1047）变得必要。

leike.en: A consistent thread: empirical, testable alignment work and honest acknowledgment of risk, not doomerism, should guide AI safety.
leike.zh: 贯穿始终的主线是：AI 安全应建立在可实证、可检验的对齐工作上，并诚实承认风险——这不是末日论，而是持续行动的理由。
